definition_zh: 游客；旅游者；观光客
definition_en: a person who travels to a place for pleasure and stays there for a short time
core_image: 戴草帽的人举着相机站在老城广场中央，仰头看教堂尖顶
scene: 夏天的老城区，拖着行李箱的人在地图前停下来拍照。A tourist asked me which street led to the castle.
sceneCN: 这里 tourist 是「游客」（第 1 个义项：为游玩而到某地短暂停留的人）；句意为一位游客问我哪条街通往城堡。广场上举着相机仰头的人，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 观光客（贬义，指走马观花的人）

derivatives.zh: 由 tourist 换后缀 -ism 构成，义为「旅游业」
tourist 的词根，义为「旅行；游览」
由 tourist 加 -y 构成，义为「游客众多的；迎合游客的」

senses.title: The camera carrier
senses.definition: a person who visits a place for pleasure, often carrying a camera or a map
senses.definitionCN: 为游玩而到某地参观的人，常带着相机或地图
senses.example: A tourist asked me which street led to the castle.
senses.exampleCN: 一位游客问我哪条街通往城堡。
senses.why: The word names the role, not the person: anyone who travels for pleasure steps into it for a while.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是一个角色而非某个人：任何为游玩而出行的人都会暂时走进这个角色。

senses.title: The shallow visitor
senses.definition: a slightly critical way of describing someone who sees only the famous sights of a place
senses.definitionCN: 略带批评地指只看一地著名景点、不求深入了解的人
senses.example: The old quarter is no longer a real neighbourhood, just a stop for tourists.
senses.exampleCN: 老城区已不再是真正的居民区，只是观光客的一站。
senses.why: Because a tourist often follows a guidebook, the word can carry the idea of seeing without understanding.
senses.whyCN: 因为游客常跟着导游手册走，这个词也带上了「看见却不理解」的意味。

senses.title: Trips made for visitors
senses.definition: used before a noun to mean connected with visitors and their travel
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，表示与游客及其出行有关的
senses.example: Tourist numbers rose sharply after the new airport opened.
senses.exampleCN: 新机场启用后游客人数大幅上升。
senses.why: The noun works as a label on things, so ticket, season and office can all wear the tourist tag.
senses.whyCN: 名词被拿来做标签贴在事物上，于是票、季节、办事处都能挂上 tourist 这个标签。

intro.en: Tourist is a modern English coinage built on tour, a word that came through French from Latin and Greek roots meaning a turning circle.
intro.cn: tourist 是近代英语在 tour 基础上造出的词，而 tour 经由法语来自拉丁语与希腊语中表示「转圈」的词根。

items.en: The noun tornos named a lathe, a tool that turns a piece of wood in a circle.
items.cn: 希腊语名词 tornos 指车床，即让木料转圈的工具。

items.en: From tornos came tornare, to turn, and then the noun tornus, a turn or a circuit.
items.cn: 由 tornos 生出动词 tornare（转），再有名词 tornus（一圈、一次周游）。

items.en: Old French made tour, a turn or a circular journey that ends where it began.
items.cn: 古法语造出 tour，指一次转身或绕行一周的旅程。

items.en: English borrowed tour, and an early tourist simply meant a person who makes a circular journey.
items.cn: 英语借入 tour，早期的 tourist 只表示作环行旅程的人。

items.en: With railways and holidays the meaning settled on the person who travels for pleasure.
items.cn: 随着铁路与假日的出现，词义固定为为游玩而出行的人。

note.en: The first group collects forms built on the same stem, the second collects other words for people who travel.
note.cn: 第一组收同一词干构成的词，第二组收其他表示出行者的词。

entries.definition: The business of providing holidays for tourists.
A journey that visits several places.
Full of tourists or made for them.
A person who is on a journey.
A person who comes to see a place or a person.
A person who goes to see famous places.

normalIntro.en: Tourist is tour plus the person ending -ist, so the word literally means one who tours.
normalIntro.cn: tourist 就是 tour 加上表示人的后缀 -ist，字面意思即「绕行游览的人」。

normal.en: -ist marks the person who does the action of the stem.
normal.cn: -ist 标记执行词干动作的人。

normal.en: Tour means a circular journey, so a tourist goes round the sights.
normal.cn: tour 意为环行旅程，所以 tourist 就是绕景点走一圈的人。

normal.en: Tourism names the whole industry, tourist names one customer.
normal.cn: tourism 指整个行业，tourist 指一位顾客。

normal.en: The stress falls on the first syllable, as in tourism.
normal.cn: 重音落在第一个音节，和 tourism 一样。

normal.en: A guidebook is written for the tourist, not by one.
normal.cn: 导游手册是写给游客的，而不是游客写的。

abstract.en: A camera raised above a crowd of heads.
abstract.cn: 人群中高举过头顶的一台相机。

abstract.en: A paper map folded until it fits one hand.
abstract.cn: 折到刚好一手能握住的一张纸质地图。

abstract.en: A suitcase wheel rattling over cobblestones.
abstract.cn: 行李箱轮子碾过石板路的响声。

examples.en: Tourists filled the square from morning until dark.
examples.cn: 游客从早到晚挤满了广场。

examples.en: Every tourist wants a photograph of the bridge at sunset.
examples.cn: 每位游客都想拍到日落时的桥。

examples.en: The town makes most of its money from tourism in summer.
examples.cn: 这个镇夏天大部分收入来自旅游业。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拓瑞斯特」——拓下瑞丽的风景，斯特外地来的客，都是游客。

root: 由 tour（旅行，源自拉丁语 tornare 转、希腊语 tornos 车床）加表示人的后缀 -ist 构成，字面即「作环行游览的人」，同族词有 tourism、touristy。

sensesIntro.en: First the person who travels for pleasure, then the shallow sightseer, then the adjective describing things made for them.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是为游玩而出行的人，再是走马观花的观光客，最后是修饰旅游事物的形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a camera lifted above a crowd.
core.cn: 核心意象：人群中高举的相机。

branches.en: The person branch: one who travels for pleasure.
branches.cn: 人分支：为游玩而旅行的人。

branches.en: The judgement branch: one who sees without understanding.
branches.cn: 评价分支：只看而不理解的人。

branches.en: The label branch: things made for such people.
branches.cn: 标签分支：为这类人准备的事物。

branches.en: The street branch: cameras and crowds on the same avenue.
branches.cn: 街道分支：同一条大街上既有相机也有人群。

branches.en: The economy branch: visitors become an industry.
branches.cn: 经济分支：来访者变成一门产业。

intro.en: Tourist is built from the free stem tour plus the agent suffix -ist, and the family grows with -ism and -y.
intro.cn: tourist 由自由词干 tour 加施动后缀 -ist 构成，词族再靠 -ism、-y 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source tornare, to turn, also yields words about turning in circles, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语词源 tornare（转）还生出若干表示转圈的词，列在下面。

items.example: The stem names the journey itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干命名旅程本身。

items.example: It forms tourist, one who tours.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tourist，即游览的人。

items.example: It forms tourism, the activity of touring.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tourism，即旅游这项活动。

items.example: It forms touristy, full of tourists.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 touristy，游客味浓的。

items.example: The tourist bought a ticket.
items.exampleCN: 那位游客买了一张票。

items.meaningCN: 不止一位这样的旅行者
items.example: Tourists arrived by coach.
items.exampleCN: 游客乘大巴而来。

items.example: The old root also gives the turning rounds of a contest.
items.exampleCN: 同一个古老词根也生出比赛中一轮轮的周转。

items.example: The Latin root survives in this everyday verb.
items.exampleCN: 那个拉丁词根留在这个日常动词里。

definition_zh: 使改变；使改观；转化；变换
definition_en: to change something completely, especially in form, appearance, or nature
core_image: 破旧的仓库在夜里被灯光点亮，变成一间明亮的画廊
scene: 旧城区的一座废弃仓库，工人们用了三年把它改成展厅。They transformed a warehouse into a museum of light.
sceneCN: 这里 transform 是「使改变；使改观」（第 1 个义项：彻底改变形式、外观或性质）；句意为他们把仓库改造成了一座关于光的博物馆。夜里被点亮的旧仓库，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 transform 加 -ation 构成，义为「转变；改造」
由 transform 加 -ative 构成，义为「有变革作用的」
由 transform 加 -er 构成，义为「变压器；改造者」

senses.title: A complete change of form
senses.definition: to change something so completely that it is no longer the same in form or nature
senses.definitionCN: 彻底改变某物，使其形式或性质与原先不同
senses.example: They transformed a warehouse into a museum of light.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把一座仓库改造成了一座关于光的博物馆。
senses.why: The Latin shape trans plus forma means across form: the thing crosses from one shape to another.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 trans 加 forma 意为「越过形式」：事物从一种形状跨到另一种形状。

senses.title: A changed appearance
senses.definition: to improve the appearance of a place or person very noticeably
senses.definitionCN: 显著改善地方或人的外观
senses.example: A coat of fresh paint transformed the front of the house.
senses.exampleCN: 一层新漆让房子的正面完全变了样。
senses.why: When only the outside changes, the word still works, because a new look is a new form.
senses.whyCN: 只改外表时这个词同样适用，因为新的样子就是新的形式。

senses.title: A change from one state to another
senses.definition: to change energy, data, or a figure from one form into another
senses.definitionCN: 把能量、数据或数值由一种形式变为另一种
senses.example: The panels transform sunlight into electricity.
senses.exampleCN: 这些板把阳光转化为电能。
senses.why: Technical use keeps the oldest sense, energy crossing from one form into another.
senses.whyCN: 技术用法保留了最古老的含义：能量从一种形式跨入另一种形式。

intro.en: Transform is a Latin compound of trans, across, and forma, shape, borrowed into English in one piece.
intro.cn: transform 是拉丁语 trans（越过）与 forma（形状）构成的复合词，整体借入英语。

items.en: Forma meant a shape or mould, the outline that gives a thing its identity.
items.cn: forma 意为形状或模子，是赋予事物身份的轮廓。

items.en: The verb transformare meant to change the shape of something.
items.cn: 动词 transformare 意为改变某物的形状。

items.en: French softened the word into transformer, still tied to shape and appearance.
items.cn: 法语把它柔化为 transformer，仍与形状、外观相连。

items.en: English took transform in the field of mathematics, where one figure becomes another.
items.cn: 英语先在数学领域使用 transform，指一个图形变为另一个图形。

items.en: The meaning widened to buildings, people, and energy, always with the sense of a complete change.
items.cn: 词义扩展到建筑、人和能量，始终带着彻底改变的意思。

note.en: The first group shares the trans stem, the second holds other verbs of change.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trans 词干，第二组收其他表示改变的动词。

entries.definition: A complete change in form.
A device that changes voltage, or one who transforms.
Able to cause a deep change.
To change into another form or use.
To change something slightly.
To give a new shape or structure.

normalIntro.en: Transform splits neatly into trans, across, and form, shape, so the meaning is visible in the spelling.
normalIntro.cn: transform 可以干净地切成 trans（跨越）与 form（形状），词义直接写在拼写里。

normal.en: Trans appears in transport and translate, all about moving across.
normal.cn: trans 也出现在 transport 与 translate 里，都与跨越有关。

normal.en: Form is the shape, so transform is to carry something over into a new shape.
normal.cn: form 是形状，所以 transform 是把某物带进新的形状。

normal.en: The stress falls on the second syllable: transFORM.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：transFORM。

normal.en: The noun adds -ation to become transformation.
normal.cn: 名词加 -ation 变成 transformation。

normal.en: A transformer in a street changes voltage from one level to another.
normal.cn: 街上的变压器把电压从一个等级换到另一个等级。

abstract.en: A grey wall turning gold under a lamp.
abstract.cn: 灰墙在灯下变成金色。

abstract.en: The same clay before and after the hands of the potter.
abstract.cn: 同一团泥在陶工手中前后的样子。

abstract.en: A door opening onto a room that was not there before.
abstract.cn: 一扇门打开后出现原本不存在的房间。

examples.en: The new railway transformed the small town into a busy city.
examples.cn: 新铁路把小镇变成了繁忙的城市。

examples.en: Learning a second language can transform the way you think.
examples.cn: 学习第二门语言能改变你思考的方式。

examples.en: Engineers transform heat into power inside the plant.
examples.cn: 工程师在厂里把热量转化为动力。

dict_mnemonic.text: trans（跨过）＋ form（形状）——跨过一个形状，进入另一个形状，就是改变。

root: 拉丁语 transformare，由 trans（越过、穿过）与 forma（形状）构成，本义「改变形状」；同族词有 transformation、transformer、transformative。

sensesIntro.en: The deepest change of form comes first, then the change of appearance, then the technical change from one state to another.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是形式上的彻底改变，再是外观的改观，最后是技术意义上从一种状态到另一种状态的转换。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old shed lit up as a gallery.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧棚屋被点成画廊。

branches.en: The form branch: one shape becomes another.
branches.cn: 形式分支：一种形状变为另一种。

branches.en: The look branch: the outside changes before the inside.
branches.cn: 外观分支：外表先于内里改变。

branches.en: The state branch: energy and data cross over.
branches.cn: 状态分支：能量与数据跨越形式。

branches.en: The technique branch: engineers use the same verb.
branches.cn: 技术分支：工程师用同一个动词。

branches.en: The human branch: a person or a place can be remade.
branches.cn: 人分支：人和地方都能被重造。

intro.en: Transform is a Latin compound whose two parts, trans and form, still work as English building blocks.
intro.cn: transform 是拉丁语复合词，其两部分 trans 与 form 至今仍是英语的构词积木。

latinIntro.en: Latin forma, shape, and trans, across, are the direct parents, and both left many relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 forma（形状）与 trans（越过）是直接来源，两者都留下众多亲属。

items.example: It carries the idea of crossing in transform.
items.exampleCN: 它把跨越的意思带进 transform。

items.example: The stem names what is being changed.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干指被改变的东西。

items.meaning: the act or result of an action
items.example: It forms transformation, the act of changing form.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transformation，改变形式的行为。

items.example: It forms transformative, able to transform.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transformative，具有改变之力的。

items.example: It forms transformer, the device or person that transforms.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transformer，进行变换的装置或人。

items.example: Re adds the sense of doing it again.
items.exampleCN: re 加上再做一次的意思。

items.example: Uni means one, so two forms become one.
items.exampleCN: uni 意为单一，于是两种样子合成一种。

items.example: A formula is a fixed shape of words or signs.
items.exampleCN: formula 就是词语或符号的固定形状。

definition_zh: 传送；传输；传播；传染；变速器
definition_en: the act of sending something such as signals or power from one place to another, the passing on of disease, or the gear system of a vehicle
core_image: 山脊上的铁塔把看不见的电流送进远处小镇的窗户
scene: 山谷里一座高压铁塔立在山脊上，导线一直伸向远处。The transmission of power across the valley began last winter.
sceneCN: 这里 transmission 是「传送；传输」（第 1 个义项：把信号、电力等从一处送到另一处）；句意为跨越山谷的电力输送在去年冬天开始运行。铁塔与导线把看不见的东西送到远方，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: transmission 的动词形式，义为「传送；传播」
由 transmit 加 -er 构成，义为「发送器；发射台」
由 transmit 加 -ible 构成，义为「可传播的；可传染的」

senses.title: Sending signals or power
senses.definition: the act or process of sending power, signals, or information from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 把电力、信号或信息从一处送到另一处的行为或过程
senses.example: The transmission of power across the valley began last winter.
senses.exampleCN: 跨越山谷的电力输送在去年冬天开始运行。
senses.why: The Latin parts trans, across, and mittere, to send, say exactly this: sending across.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 parts trans（跨越）与 mittere（送）说的正是这件事：跨越着送出去。

senses.title: Passing on disease
senses.definition: the passing of an infection or a habit from one person or animal to another
senses.definitionCN: 感染或习惯从一人或一动物传给另一人
senses.example: Washing hands reduces the transmission of infection.
senses.exampleCN: 洗手能减少感染的传播。
senses.why: A germ travels from body to body, so the same word covers a crossing that nobody can see.
senses.whyCN: 病菌从一个身体走到另一个身体，于是同一个词容纳了这种看不见的跨越。

senses.title: A broadcast on air
senses.definition: a programme that is sent out by radio or television
senses.definitionCN: 由广播或电视发出的节目
senses.example: The concert was recorded for transmission in the spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这场音乐会被录制下来，准备在春天播出。
senses.why: Signals leave the tower and reach many receivers at once, and the result is called a transmission.
senses.whyCN: 信号离开发射塔同时抵达许多接收机，其结果就叫一次 transmission。

senses.title: The gears of a car
senses.definition: the part of a vehicle that carries power from the engine to the wheels
senses.definitionCN: 车辆中把动力从发动机传到车轮的部件
senses.example: The mechanic found a leak in the transmission.
senses.exampleCN: 修理工发现变速器有渗漏。
senses.why: Mechanical use names the gearbox because its whole job is to transmit turning force.
senses.whyCN: 机械用法把变速箱叫这个名字，因为它全部的职责就是传送转动力。

intro.en: Transmission joins trans, across, with the Latin verb mittere, to send, and its noun missio, a sending.
intro.cn: transmission 由 trans（越过）与拉丁语动词 mittere（送）及其名词 missio（送出）结合而成。

items.en: Mittere meant to send or to let go, a common verb of motion.
items.cn: mittere 意为送出、放走，是常用的运动动词。

items.en: Transmissio named the act of sending something across or through.
items.cn: transmissio 指把某物送过或送穿的动作。

items.en: French passed the word on as transmission, still meaning a crossing over.
items.cn: 法语以 transmission 传出，仍含有穿越之意。

items.en: Early English use concerned the passing on of property or of disease.
items.cn: 英语早期用法涉及财产或疾病的传承。

items.en: With radio and engines the word grew two new homes: broadcasting and gears.
items.cn: 随着无线电与发动机出现，这个词多了两个新家：广播与齿轮箱。

note.en: The first group shares the mit stem, the second holds other words for sending and spreading.
note.cn: 第一组共享 mit 词干，第二组收其他表示发送与扩散的词。

entries.definition: To send signals or pass on disease.
A device that sends out signals.
Able to be passed from one to another.
A programme sent out to many receivers.
The act of carrying something.
A move from one place to another.

normalIntro.en: Transmission carries the prefix trans and the mission stem, so its spelling tells the whole story of sending across.
normalIntro.cn: transmission 带着前缀 trans 与 mission 词干，拼写本身就讲完了「送过去」的故事。

normal.en: Mission here is not a task but the Latin sending.
normal.cn: 这里的 mission 不是任务，而是拉丁语的「送出」。

normal.en: The plural only adds s: transmissions.
normal.cn: 复数只加 s：transmissions。

normal.en: The stress sits on the second syllable: transMISsion.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：transMISsion。

normal.en: Transmit is the verb, transmitter is the device that does it.
normal.cn: transmit 是动词，transmitter 是执行它的设备。

normal.en: A car with an automatic transmission shifts gear by itself.
normal.cn: 带自动变速器的车会自己换挡。

abstract.en: A thin wire humming above a valley.
abstract.cn: 山谷上方嗡嗡作响的一根细线。

abstract.en: A voice arriving from a room no one can see.
abstract.cn: 从看不见的房间里传来的声音。

abstract.en: One hand quietly passing a small object to the next.
abstract.cn: 一只手悄悄把一个小东西传给下一只手。

examples.en: The transmission of data between the two offices takes less than a second.
examples.cn: 两个办公室之间的数据传输用时不到一秒。

examples.en: Doctors are studying how the virus spreads from person to person.
examples.cn: 医生们正在研究这种病毒如何在人际间传播。

examples.en: The old truck needs a new transmission before winter.
examples.cn: 这辆旧卡车入冬前需要换新的变速器。

dict_mnemonic.text: trans（越过）＋ mission（送出）——把东西越过距离送出去，就是传输。

root: 拉丁语 transmissio，由 trans（越过）与 mittere（送）的分词词干 miss- 构成，本义「送过去」；同族词有 transmit、transmitter、transmissible。

sensesIntro.en: Power and signals first, then disease, then broadcasting, then the gearbox that carries turning force to the wheels.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是电力与信号，再是疾病，然后是广播，最后是把转动力送到车轮的变速器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a humming wire over a valley.
core.cn: 核心意象：山谷上方嗡嗡作响的导线。

branches.en: The power branch: energy and data sent across.
branches.cn: 动力分支：被送过去的能量与数据。

branches.en: The illness branch: an infection crossing between bodies.
branches.cn: 疾病分支：感染在身体之间跨越。

branches.en: The broadcast branch: one signal reaching many.
branches.cn: 广播分支：一个信号抵达许多地方。

branches.en: The machine branch: force sent from engine to wheel.
branches.cn: 机械分支：力从发动机送到车轮。

branches.en: The invisible branch: all of it is a sending no eye can follow.
branches.cn: 无形分支：全都是眼睛跟不上的送出。

intro.en: Transmission is built from the prefix trans and the Latin root mit, with the noun ending -ion on top.
intro.cn: transmission 由前缀 trans、拉丁词根 mit 以及名词结尾 -ion 叠加而成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb mittere, to send, supplies the core of the word and of many other English verbs.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语动词 mittere（送）提供了这个词以及许多英语动词的核心。

items.example: It marks the direction of the sending.
items.exampleCN: 它标出送出的方向。

items.example: The root carries the action of sending.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根承载发送的动作。

items.example: It turns the action into a thing, a transmission.
items.exampleCN: 它把动作变成事物，即一次传输。

items.example: The verb is the bare action.
items.exampleCN: 动词是纯粹的动作。

items.example: The device sends the signal out.
items.exampleCN: 这个装置把信号发出去。

items.example: It forms transmissible, able to be passed on.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transmissible，能被传递的。

items.example: The noun keeps the old sense of being sent.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词保留了「被送出」的古义。

items.example: Sub means under, so the sending goes downward.
items.exampleCN: sub 意为在下，于是送出是朝下的。

items.meaning: to send toward, hence let in
items.example: Ad means to, so the sending goes inward.
items.exampleCN: ad 意为朝向，于是送出是朝内的。

definition_zh: 传送；发射；传输；传播（疾病、情感）
definition_en: to send out signals, to pass something such as a disease or a feeling to others, or to send power through a wire
core_image: 山顶天线在雨里一闪一闪地把声音发向云层
scene: 雨夜的广播站，天线塔顶端的红灯一亮一暗。The station transmits news to the whole coast every hour.
sceneCN: 这里 transmit 是「发射；传送」（第 1 个义项：把信号发出去）；句意为这家电台每小时向整个海岸发送一次新闻。雨里一闪一闪的天线，就是这个词的形象。

derivatives.zh: 由 transmit 加 -ssion 构成，义为「传送；传输」
由 transmit 加 -er 构成，义为「发射机；传送者」
由 transmit 加 -able 构成，义为「可传送的；可传播的」

senses.title: Sending a signal out
senses.definition: to send out an electronic signal such as radio waves or a picture
senses.definitionCN: 发出无线电波、图像等电子信号
senses.example: The station transmits news to the whole coast every hour.
senses.exampleCN: 这家电台每小时向整个海岸发送一次新闻。
senses.why: Latin mittere means to send, and trans adds the direction, so the verb is simply to send across.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 mittere 意为送，trans 补上方向，于是这个动词就是「送过去」。

senses.title: Passing on illness
senses.definition: to pass an infection or a parasite from one living thing to another
senses.definitionCN: 把感染或寄生虫从一种生物传给另一种
senses.example: Mosquitoes can transmit several dangerous fevers.
senses.exampleCN: 蚊子能传播好几种危险的发热病。
senses.why: When a mosquito carries a germ to a new body, it does exactly what a wire does with a signal.
senses.whyCN: 当蚊子把病菌带到新的身体里，它做的事和导线对待信号完全一样。

senses.title: Carrying heat or force
senses.definition: to allow heat, sound, or force to pass through a material
senses.definitionCN: 让热、声或力通过某种材料传过
senses.example: Metal transmits heat faster than wood.
senses.exampleCN: 金属导热比木头快。
senses.why: Physics borrowed the everyday verb because energy also crosses from one place to another.
senses.whyCN: 物理学借用了这个日常动词，因为能量也同样从一处走到另一处。

senses.title: Passing on a feeling
senses.definition: to make other people feel the emotion you feel
senses.definitionCN: 让别人感受到你所感受的情绪
senses.example: Her calm voice transmitted confidence to the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 她平静的声音把信心传给了整支队伍。
senses.why: A feeling can travel from one mind to another, so the word reaches beyond wires and bodies.
senses.whyCN: 情绪能从一个心灵传到另一个心灵，于是这个词越过了导线与身体。

intro.en: Transmit is the Latin verb transmittere, to send across, taken into English with its two parts still visible.
intro.cn: transmit 是拉丁语动词 transmittere（送过去）原样进入英语，两部分仍然清晰可见。

items.en: Mittere, to send, is one of the busiest verbs of Latin motion.
items.cn: mittere（送）是拉丁语中最常用的运动动词之一。

items.en: Transmittere meant to send a thing over or through, from a hand to a place.
items.cn: transmittere 意为把东西送过或送穿，从一只手到一处地方。

items.en: French kept transmettre, used for handing on property as well as objects.
items.cn: 法语保留 transmettre，既用于递交物品也用于转让财产。

items.en: English took transmit first for the passing on of disease and of rights.
items.cn: 英语最初用 transmit 表示疾病与权利的传递。

items.en: Telegraph and radio gave the verb its modern electronic sense.
items.cn: 电报与无线电赋予这个动词现代的电子含义。

note.en: The first group shows forms of the same verb, the second shows other verbs of sending and spreading.
note.cn: 第一组是同一动词的各种形式，第二组是其他表示发送与扩散的动词。

entries.definition: The act of sending or passing on.
A device that sends out signals.
Sent out or passed on in the past.
To send out a programme to many listeners.
To carry or make a feeling understood.
To move over a wider area.

normalIntro.en: Transmit keeps the trans of crossing and the mit of sending, and doubles its t before endings.
normalIntro.cn: transmit 保留 trans（跨越）与 mit（送），在加词尾前要把 t 双写。

normal.en: Mit is the same root as in submit and admit.
normal.cn: mit 与 submit、admit 里的词根相同。

normal.en: The past tense doubles the last letter: transmitted.
normal.cn: 过去式双写末字母：transmitted。

normal.en: The stress falls on the second syllable: transMIT.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：transMIT。

normal.en: A transmitter does the sending, a transmission is the sending itself.
normal.cn: transmitter 执行发送，transmission 是发送这件事。

normal.en: Radio waves transmit without any wire at all.
normal.cn: 无线电波根本不需要导线就能传送。

abstract.en: A red light blinking on a tower at night.
abstract.cn: 夜里塔上闪烁的一点红光。

abstract.en: A word leaving one mouth and arriving in many ears.
abstract.cn: 一句话离开一张嘴，落进许多只耳朵。

abstract.en: Heat moving quietly along a metal spoon.
abstract.cn: 热安静地沿着金属勺子移动。

examples.en: The tower transmits the signal to ships far out at sea.
examples.cn: 这座塔把信号传送给远在海上的船只。

examples.en: Some insects transmit disease when they bite.
examples.cn: 有些昆虫叮咬时会传播疾病。

examples.en: Copper transmits electricity better than iron.
examples.cn: 铜导电比铁好。

dict_mnemonic.text: trans（越过）＋ mit（送）——把信号送越距离，就是发射传送。

root: 拉丁语 transmittere，trans（越过）＋ mittere（送），本义「送过去」；同族词有 transmission、transmitter、transmittable。

sensesIntro.en: The electronic signal comes first, then disease, then heat and force, then feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是电子信号，再是疾病，然后是热与力，最后是情感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tower light blinking in rain.
core.cn: 核心意象：雨里闪烁的塔灯。

branches.en: The signal branch: waves leaving the antenna.
branches.cn: 信号分支：离开天线的波。

branches.en: The illness branch: germs carried by a bite.
branches.cn: 疾病分支：被叮咬带走的病菌。

branches.en: The material branch: heat allowed to pass through.
branches.cn: 材料分支：允许热穿过的物体。

branches.en: The feeling branch: calm travelling to others.
branches.cn: 情感分支：平静传给他人。

branches.en: The unseen branch: nothing visible ever moves.
branches.cn: 无形分支：看不见任何东西真正移动。

intro.en: Transmit is trans plus the Latin root mit, and it gains -er, -able and -ssion in its family.
intro.cn: transmit 是 trans 加拉丁词根 mit，词族中再加 -er、-able 与 -ssion。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root mittere, to send, appears in many English verbs, four of which are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 mittere（送）出现在许多英语动词中，下面列出其中四条。

items.example: The prefix sets the direction of the sending.
items.exampleCN: 前缀确定发送的方向。

items.example: The root supplies the meaning of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 词根提供动词的核心义。

items.example: It forms transmitter, the sending device.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transmitter，发送装置。

items.example: It forms transmittable, able to be passed on.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transmittable，可被传递的。

items.example: The sending goes downward under authority.
items.exampleCN: 送出朝下，置于权威之下。

items.meaning: to send toward, hence let in
items.example: The sending goes toward the inside.
items.exampleCN: 送出朝向内部。

items.example: Per means through, so the way is open.
items.exampleCN: per 意为穿过，于是道路敞开。

items.example: Com means together, so the act binds both sides.
items.exampleCN: com 意为共同，于是这个行为把双方绑在一起。

definition_zh: 透明的；清澈的；易懂的；公开的
definition_en: clear enough to see through, easy to understand, or open for everyone to see
core_image: 清晨的窗玻璃干净得像不存在，树枝的影子直接落在桌面
scene: 雪后的早晨，窗玻璃擦得发亮，外面的鸟落在枝上。The lake was so transparent that we saw stones on the bottom.
sceneCN: 这里 transparent 是「透明的；清澈的」（第 1 个义项：能看清后面东西的）；句意为湖水清澈得能看见水底的石头。擦得很亮的窗和清得见底的水，都是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 transparent 加 -cy 构成，义为「透明；透明度」
由 transparent 加 -ly 构成，义为「透明地；显然地」
由 semi-（半）与 transparent 复合，义为「半透明的」

senses.title: Seeing straight through
senses.definition: clear enough for light to pass through, so objects behind can be seen
senses.definitionCN: 足够清澈让光线通过，因而能看见后面的物体
senses.example: The lake was so transparent that we saw stones on the bottom.
senses.exampleCN: 湖水清澈得能看见水底的石头。
senses.why: Latin trans, through, plus parere, to appear, means letting light appear through the body.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 trans（穿过）加 parere（显现），意为让光穿过物体显现出来。

senses.title: Water you can look into
senses.definition: used of water that is free of mud or cloudiness
senses.definitionCN: 用于形容水中没有泥沙或浑浊物
senses.example: Children watched the transparent stream flow over the pebbles.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们看着清澈的小溪流过卵石。
senses.why: Clear water is the everyday picture of the whole idea, so the adjective drifted into it naturally.
senses.whyCN: 清水是这一概念的日常画面，形容词自然就延伸到了这里。

senses.title: Easy to follow
senses.definition: expressed so simply that nobody can misunderstand it
senses.definitionCN: 表达得简单明了，不会被误解
senses.example: Her explanation was transparent even to the beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 即使是初学者也能听懂她的解释。
senses.why: If nothing hides the meaning, the words are transparent in the same way glass is.
senses.whyCN: 如果没有任何东西遮住含义，那么这些词就像玻璃一样透明。

senses.title: Open to inspection
senses.definition: used of rules or actions that anyone may examine and judge
senses.definitionCN: 用于形容任何人可以查看与评判的规则或行为
senses.example: The committee promised a transparent selection process.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会承诺采用公开透明的选拔流程。
senses.why: Modern politics borrowed the glass image for institutions that have nothing to hide.
senses.whyCN: 现代政治借用了玻璃的意象，形容没什么可隐藏的机构。

intro.en: Transparent comes from the Latin verb transparere, to show through, made of trans, through, and parere, to appear.
intro.cn: transparent 来自拉丁语动词 transparere（透出），由 trans（穿过）与 parere（显现）组成。

items.en: Parere meant to come into sight or be visible, the root of appear.
items.cn: parere 意为出现、可见，是 appear 的词根。

items.en: Transparens described bodies that let light pass and show what lies behind.
items.cn: transparens 形容能让光透过、显出背后事物的物体。

items.en: French borrowed it in the sense of showing light through a material.
items.cn: 法语借入时指让光透过材料显现出来。

items.en: English extended the adjective from glass and water to arguments and excuses.
items.cn: 英语把这个形容词从玻璃和水扩展到论证与借口。

items.en: Public life adopted the word for open government and honest rules.
items.cn: 公共生活借用它来指开放的政府与诚实的规则。

note.en: The first group shares the par, to appear, stem, the second holds other words about clarity.
note.cn: 第一组共享 par（显现）词干，第二组收其他表示清晰的词。

entries.definition: The quality of being clear or open.
In a clear and open way.
Clearly visible or seeming true.
Easy to see through or understand.
Letting light through without showing shapes clearly.
So thin or clear that shapes show through.

normalIntro.en: Transparent can be read as trans plus parent: something you can see straight through to the others behind it.
normalIntro.cn: transparent 可以读成 trans 加 parent：你能一眼看穿它，看到后面的东西。

normal.en: Par is the appear root of apparent and appear.
normal.cn: par 是 apparent 与 appear 里表示「显现」的词根。

normal.en: Trans moves across, so light moves straight through.
normal.cn: trans 是穿过，于是光笔直透过去。

normal.en: The noun ends in -cy: transparency.
normal.cn: 名词以 -cy 结尾：transparency。

normal.en: Stress falls on the second syllable: transPARent.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：transPARent。

normal.en: A transparent excuse is one that hides nothing, including the truth.
normal.cn: transparent excuse 是不藏东西的借口，包括不藏真相。

abstract.en: A window so clean that the tree seems to stand indoors.
abstract.cn: 窗户干净得树仿佛长在屋里。

abstract.en: A glass of water on white paper, almost invisible.
abstract.cn: 白纸上一杯几乎看不见的水。

abstract.en: A sentence that lets the meaning through without a shadow.
abstract.cn: 一句让意思毫无阴影地穿过的话。

examples.en: The lid is transparent, so you can watch the seeds grow.
examples.cn: 盖子透明，所以你能看到种子发芽。

examples.en: The river runs transparent over smooth grey stones.
examples.cn: 河水清澈地流过光滑的灰石。

examples.en: Their rules of choosing members are written in a transparent way.
examples.cn: 他们选择成员的规则写得清楚透明。

dict_mnemonic.text: trans（穿过）＋ parent（显现）——光穿过它还能显出后面，就是透明的。

root: 拉丁语 transparere（透出），trans（穿过）＋parere（显现、出现），词干 par- 也见于 apparent、appear；同族词有 transparency、transparently。

sensesIntro.en: Glass first, then clear water, then clear words, then open institutions.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是玻璃，再是清水，然后是明白的话语，最后是公开的机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a window so clean it almost vanishes.
core.cn: 核心意象：干净得几乎消失的窗。

branches.en: The glass branch: light passes and objects appear.
branches.cn: 玻璃分支：光穿过，物体显现。

branches.en: The water branch: nothing cloudy blocks the view.
branches.cn: 水分支：没有浑物挡住视线。

branches.en: The language branch: meaning shows through the words.
branches.cn: 语言分支：意思透过词显现。

branches.en: The institution branch: nothing is kept out of sight.
branches.cn: 机构分支：没有东西被藏起来。

branches.en: The image branch: glass and sentences share one picture.
branches.cn: 意象分支：玻璃与句子共用同一幅画。

intro.en: Transparent combines the Latin prefix trans with the stem par, to appear, and adds -ent as an adjective ending.
intro.cn: transparent 把拉丁前缀 trans 与词干 par（显现）结合，并以 -ent 作形容词结尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin parere, to appear, also gives apparent and the verb appear, all built on the same stem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 parere（显现）还生出 apparent 与动词 appear，都建在同一词干上。

items.example: It tells us the light passes through.
items.exampleCN: 它告诉我们光穿了过去。

items.example: The stem gives the idea of showing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干给出显现的意思。

items.example: It makes the stem an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把词干变成形容词。

items.example: It forms transparency, the state of being clear.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transparency，透明的状态。

items.example: It forms transparently, in a clear way.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transparently，透明地。

items.example: The same stem appears here without trans.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干在这里出现，只是没有 trans。

items.example: The verb keeps the plain sense of showing.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词保留了显现的朴素含义。

items.example: It forms semi-transparent, partly see-through.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 semi-transparent，部分透明的。

definition_zh: 条约；协议；协定
definition_en: a formal written agreement between two or more countries, signed by their governments
core_image: 长桌两端两位代表同时落笔，纸页上并排着两种文字的签名
scene: 大厅里两张长桌拼在一起，两国的代表各自翻开文件夹。The two countries signed a peace treaty after a year of talks.
sceneCN: 这里 treaty 是「条约」（第 1 个义项：两国或多国政府签署的正式书面协议）；句意为经过一年谈判，两国签署了和平条约。长桌上并排的两份签名，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: treaty 的词源动词，义为「对待；谈判」
由 treat 加 -ment 构成，义为「对待；处理」
与 treaty 同源的词，义为「论文；专著」

senses.title: The signed paper
senses.definition: a formal agreement between states, written down and signed by those in power
senses.definitionCN: 国家之间写下并由掌权者签署的正式协议
senses.example: The two countries signed a peace treaty after a year of talks.
senses.exampleCN: 经过一年谈判，两国签署了和平条约。
senses.why: Medieval Latin tractatus meant a handling or a discussion, and a treaty is the paper produced when talks end.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语 tractatus 意为处理或讨论，treaty 就是讨论结束后产生的那份文书。

senses.title: A deal between groups
senses.definition: an agreement of the same kind made by other large bodies such as companies
senses.definitionCN: 公司等大型机构之间订立的同类协议
senses.example: The two firms signed a treaty on sharing the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司就共用港口签署了一份协议。
senses.why: The word began to travel from governments to any body large enough to act like one.
senses.whyCN: 这个词开始从政府延伸到任何大到能像政府一样行动的机构。

intro.en: Treaty comes from the Latin verb tractare, to handle or discuss, through the noun tractatus, a discussion.
intro.cn: treaty 经由名词 tractatus（讨论）来自拉丁语动词 tractare（处理、商谈）。

items.en: Tractare meant to drag, handle, and later to discuss or negotiate.
items.cn: tractare 意为拖动、处理，后来指讨论与商谈。

items.en: Tractatus named a treatment or a written discussion of a subject.
items.cn: tractatus 指一次处理，或对某主题的书面论述。

items.en: French made traitie, a discussion that ends in an agreement.
items.cn: 法语造出 traitie，指以协议告终的商讨。

items.en: English treaty first meant any negotiation between rulers.
items.cn: 中古英语的 treaty 最初指统治者之间的任何谈判。

items.en: By the modern period the word meant the signed document itself.
items.cn: 到了近代，这个词指已签署的文件本身。

note.en: The first group shares the tract stem, the second holds other words for formal agreements.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tract 词干，第二组收其他表示正式协定的词。

entries.definition: To behave toward someone or to give medical care.
The way a person or thing is handled.
A long written work on a subject.
An arrangement accepted by both sides.
A firm promise between parties.
A formal settlement between states.

normalIntro.en: Treaty hides the same root as treat: talks that end in a treaty are talks that have been handled to a finish.
normalIntro.cn: treaty 藏着与 treat 相同的词根：以条约结束的谈判，就是把事情处理到底的商谈。

normal.en: The plural changes y to ies: treaties.
normal.cn: 复数把 y 变 ies：treaties。

normal.en: The word begins with treat, the everyday verb.
normal.cn: 这个词以日常动词 treat 开头。

normal.en: A peace treaty is the most common phrase of all.
normal.cn: peace treaty 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: TREAty.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：TREAty。

normal.en: A treaty is signed, broken, or kept, like a promise on paper.
normal.cn: 条约和纸上的承诺一样，会被签署、违反或遵守。

abstract.en: Two pens meeting on the same line.
abstract.cn: 两支笔落在同一条线上。

abstract.en: A page with two languages and two seals.
abstract.cn: 一张写着两种语言、盖着两枚印章的纸。

abstract.en: The silence after the last signature.
abstract.cn: 最后一个签名之后的那份安静。

examples.en: Both sides hope to reach a treaty before the winter.
examples.cn: 双方希望在入冬前达成一项条约。

examples.en: The old treaty fixed the border along the river.
examples.cn: 旧条约以河流划定边界。

examples.en: They met to discuss a trade agreement between the neighbours.
examples.cn: 他们开会讨论邻国之间的贸易协定。

dict_mnemonic.text: treat（商谈处理）＋ y——商谈到底后签下的那张纸，就是条约。

root: 经由古法语 traitie 来自拉丁语 tractatus（处理、讨论），词根 tract- 意为「拉、处理」；同源词有 treat、treatment、treatise。

sensesIntro.en: First the signed document between states, then the same kind of deal between large bodies.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是国家之间签署的文件，再是大型机构之间的同类协议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two pens landing on the same line.
core.cn: 核心意象：两支笔落在同一行上。

branches.en: The state branch: an agreement between governments.
branches.cn: 国家分支：政府之间的协议。

branches.en: The body branch: a deal between large groups.
branches.cn: 机构分支：大集团之间的协议。

branches.en: The paper branch: both end in a signed document.
branches.cn: 文书分支：两者都以签署的文件告终。

branches.en: The border branch: treaties draw lines on maps.
branches.cn: 边界分支：条约在地图上画线。

branches.en: The talk branch: all of it begins as discussion.
branches.cn: 商谈分支：一切从讨论开始。

intro.en: Treaty is built on the Latin stem tract, drawn or handled, with an Old French noun ending on top.
intro.cn: treaty 建在拉丁词干 tract（拉、处理）之上，外面套着古法语的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere, to pull, gives the family of tract, treat, and treaty, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere（拉）生出 tract、treat 与 treaty 这一词族，列在下面。

items.example: The root links pulling and dealing with people.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根把「拉」与「应对人」连在一起。

items.example: It turns the handling into a document.
items.exampleCN: 它把处理的过程变成一份文件。

items.meaning: to behave toward, to deal with
items.example: The verb keeps the plain sense of handling.
items.exampleCN: 动词保留处理的朴素含义。

items.example: The noun names the finished paper.
items.exampleCN: 名词指完成的文书。

items.example: Ment marks the manner of handling.
items.exampleCN: ment 标记处理的方式。

items.example: A treatise handles a subject on paper.
items.exampleCN: treatise 在纸上处理一个主题。

items.example: Here the root pulls in a literal sense.
items.exampleCN: 这里词根是字面意义上的拉。

items.example: Ad means toward, so things are pulled near.
items.exampleCN: ad 意为朝向，于是把东西拉近。

definition_zh: 树；树木；树状图
definition_en: a tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches, or a branching diagram
core_image: 一棵大树在空地上撑开满枝的绿，树影铺过整条路
scene: 村口的空地上站着一棵老树，枝叶向四面伸展。An old tree at the village gate shades the whole road.
sceneCN: 这里 tree 是「树；树木」（第 1 个义项：有木质树干和枝条的高大植物）；句意为村口一棵老树把整条路都遮在荫里。空地上撑开枝叶的那棵老树，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 tree 加 -less 构成，义为「没有树的；无树木的」
由 tree 与 lined 复合，义为「两旁有树的」
由 tree 与 top 复合，义为「树梢」

senses.title: The tall plant
senses.definition: a plant with a hard wooden stem that grows tall and lives for many years
senses.definitionCN: 有坚硬木质主干、长得高大且寿命多年的植物
senses.example: An old tree at the village gate shades the whole road.
senses.exampleCN: 村口一棵老树把整条路都遮在荫里。
senses.why: The word has stayed close to its old English shape for more than a thousand years, naming the same thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个词一千多年来与它古英语的形态几乎不变，指的一直是同一件事。

senses.title: The branching drawing
senses.definition: a diagram whose lines branch out like the limbs of a tree
senses.definitionCN: 线条像树枝一样分岔的图表
senses.example: She drew the family tree on the back of an envelope.
senses.exampleCN: 她在信封背面画出了家谱。
senses.why: Because a trunk divides into branches, any chart that divides in this way borrows the word.
senses.whyCN: 因为树干分叉成枝，任何按这种方式分岔的图表都借用了这个词。

senses.title: Planting a memory
senses.definition: a tree planted to mark a person, an event, or a promise for the future
senses.definitionCN: 为纪念某人、某事或对未来的承诺而种下的树
senses.example: They planted a tree at the gate when their daughter was born.
senses.exampleCN: 女儿出生时，他们在门口种了一棵树。
senses.why: A tree outlives the person who plants it, so it became a living record, and the word carries that hope.
senses.whyCN: 树比种它的人活得更久，于是它成了一份活着的记录，这个词也带上了这种期望。

intro.en: Tree is one of the oldest words in English, unchanged in meaning since the Germanic period.
intro.cn: tree 是英语中最古老的词之一，自日耳曼语时期起词义未曾改变。

items.en: The Germanic root trewam named wood, tree, and the material of timber.
items.cn: 日耳曼语词根 trewam 指树、木以及木材。

items.en: Old English treow meant both a tree and the idea of faithfulness, a pair still visible in true.
items.cn: 古英语 treow 既指树，也指忠信，这一双义仍留在 true 里。

items.en: Middle English tre kept the plant sense and dropped the abstract one.
items.cn: 中古英语 tre 保留了植物的意义，舍弃了抽象义。

items.en: The spelling tree settled in the modern period.
items.cn: tree 这个拼写在近代固定下来。

items.en: Compounds such as treetop and tree-lined later built a whole family around it.
items.cn: treetop 与 tree-lined 等复合词后来围绕它建起整个词族。

note.en: The first group collects woody plants, the second collects branching or related forms.
note.cn: 第一组是木本植物，第二组是带枝干意象的词与相关形式。

entries.definition: The highest part of a tree.
Having no trees.
Having trees along its sides.
A low woody plant with many stems.
A small woody plant, smaller than a tree.
Wood prepared for building.

normalIntro.en: Tree is short and long-lived, a word whose sound has barely moved in a thousand years.
normalIntro.cn: tree 短小而长久，这个词的读音一千年几乎没变。

normal.en: The ending ee is long, like the vowel in see.
normal.cn: 词尾 ee 读长音，像 see 里的元音。

normal.en: A family tree draws people as branches.
normal.cn: 家谱把人画成枝条。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: trees.
normal.cn: 复数只加 s：trees。

normal.en: Treetop and treeline both put the tree first.
normal.cn: treetop 与 treeline 都把 tree 放在前面。

normal.en: The old meaning of faithfulness survives in the word true.
normal.cn: 忠信的古义留在 true 这个词里。

abstract.en: A trunk going up and then becoming many things.
abstract.cn: 一根树干向上走，然后变成许多东西。

abstract.en: Shade moving slowly across a road.
abstract.cn: 荫影缓慢地爬过一条路。

abstract.en: Roots as thick below as branches above.
abstract.cn: 地下的根和上面的枝一样粗。

examples.en: Two children are climbing the tree by the wall.
examples.cn: 两个孩子正在爬墙边的树。

examples.en: The branches of the apple tree touched the roof.
examples.cn: 苹果树的枝条碰到了屋顶。

examples.en: He traced the family branches back four hundred years.
examples.cn: 他把这支家谱追到了四百年前。

dict_mnemonic.text: tree 读音像「吹」——风一吹，满树的叶子都在动。

root: 古英语 treow，来自日耳曼语词根 trewam（木、树），与 true 的「忠信」古义同源；同族词有 treetop、treeless、tree-lined。

sensesIntro.en: First the living plant, then any diagram whose parts branch the way a tree does.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是活着的植物，再是任何像树一样分岔的图表。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a broad old tree shading a road.
core.cn: 核心意象：遮住一条路的老树。

branches.en: The plant branch: root, trunk, and leaf.
branches.cn: 植物分支：根、干与叶。

branches.en: The chart branch: lines that divide like limbs.
branches.cn: 图表分支：像枝干一样分开的线。

branches.en: The shape branch: both share one silhouette.
branches.cn: 形状分支：两者共有一个轮廓。

branches.en: The shade branch: a living tree changes the street.
branches.cn: 荫影分支：活树改变了街道。

branches.en: The family branch: names placed on the limbs.
branches.cn: 家族分支：名字被放到枝条上。

intro.en: Tree is a free Germanic stem that joins freely with other words to make compounds.
intro.cn: tree 是日耳曼语系的自由词干，可以自由与其他词组合成复合词。

latinIntro.en: The tree word itself is Germanic, but Latin supplies the woodland words below.
latinIntro.cn: 树这个词本身来自日耳曼语，但下面的林地词汇出自拉丁语。

items.example: The stem stands on its own as a full noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干本身就是一个完整名词。

items.example: It forms treeless, without any trees.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 treeless，没有树的。

items.example: It forms treetop, the crown of a tree.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 treetop，树冠。

items.example: It forms tree-lined, with trees along the street.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tree-lined，街道两旁有树。

items.example: Trees were planted along the river.
items.exampleCN: 沿河种下了树。

items.meaning: a shelter built in a tree
items.example: The children built a treehouse in summer.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们夏天搭了一座树屋。

items.meaning: the height above which trees cannot grow
items.example: Above the treeline only grass survives.
items.exampleCN: 林木线以上只有草能存活。

items.meaning: the upper branches of a tree
items.example: Birds gathered in the treetop.
items.exampleCN: 鸟聚在树梢上。

definition_zh: 趋势；倾向；潮流；走向
definition_en: a general direction in which something is developing or changing over time
core_image: 纸上一条折线慢慢向上爬，旁边标着几个年份
scene: 办公室里，分析师把几年的销量画成折线，线在最后一段明显上扬。The trend in sales has been upward for three years.
sceneCN: 这里 trend 是「趋势；走向」（第 1 个义项：事物随时间发展的总方向）；句意为销量的走势三年来一直在上升。纸上那条慢慢上扬的折线，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 trend 加 -y 构成，义为「时髦的；赶潮流的」
由 trend 与 setter 复合，义为「引领潮流的人」
由 trend 加 -ing 构成，义为「正在流行的」

senses.title: The line on the graph
senses.definition: the general direction in which a situation is moving over a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 情况在一段时间内发展的总方向
senses.example: The trend in sales has been upward for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 销量的走势三年来一直在上升。
senses.why: The word began as a turning of a river or a coast, and a line that keeps turning one way became a trend.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指河流或海岸的转弯，而一直朝一边转的线就成了趋势。

senses.title: What everyone is doing
senses.definition: a fashion or habit that many people take up at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 许多人同时接受的时髦做法
senses.example: Short jackets are the trend this autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 短外套是今年秋天的潮流。
senses.why: When many people turn the same way at once, the direction looks like a fashion to follow.
senses.whyCN: 当许多人同时转向同一个方向，这个方向看起来就像可以追随的风尚。

senses.title: Leaning in one direction
senses.definition: to move or develop generally in a stated direction
senses.definitionCN: 大体朝某个方向移动或发展
senses.example: Prices trended downward through the summer.
senses.exampleCN: 整个夏天价格趋于下降。
senses.why: The verb keeps the oldest picture: a course that keeps bending the same way.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了最古老的画面：一条一直朝同一方向弯的走向。

senses.title: Turning away from a fashion
senses.definition: to move away from a popular style in a new direction
senses.definitionCN: 离开流行样式，转向新的方向
senses.example: Designers are turning away from bright colours this year.
senses.exampleCN: 设计师今年正逐渐远离鲜亮的颜色。
senses.why: The verb keeps the old idea of a course bending, and fashion courses bend too.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词保留着航线折弯的旧意，时尚的走向同样会折弯。

intro.en: Trend first named the turning of a coastline or a river, and only later the direction of a set of figures.
intro.cn: trend 最初指海岸线或河流的转弯，后来才指一组数字的方向。

items.en: The verb trendan meant to turn or revolve, close to the modern tr-, dr- turn family.
items.cn: 古英语动词 trendan 意为转动、旋转，与表示「转」的词族相近。

items.en: A trend was the curve of a shore or the bend of a river.
items.cn: 中古英语里 trend 指海岸的弧线或河流的弯处。

items.en: Sailors spoke of the trend of a coast as its general direction.
items.cn: 水手用 the trend of a coast 指海岸的大致走向。

items.en: Statistics borrowed the word for the general direction of changing numbers.
items.cn: 统计学借用这个词，指变化中的数字的总方向。

items.en: Twentieth-century magazines applied it to fashion, giving the sense of a popular style.
items.cn: 二十世纪的杂志把它用在时尚上，产生了流行风潮的含义。

note.en: The first group shares the trend stem, the second holds other words for direction and fashion.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trend 词干，第二组收其他表示方向与流行的词。

entries.definition: Very fashionable.
Currently popular online.
A person who starts a fashion.
A leaning toward a kind of behaviour.
A popular style at a given time.
The line along which something moves.

normalIntro.en: Trend is a short word for a long line: the way things have been going and are likely to keep going.
normalIntro.cn: trend 是个短词，说的是长线：事情一路走来的方向，以及大概会继续走下去的方向。

normal.en: The verb is the same word: prices trend up.
normal.cn: 动词形式一模一样：prices trend up。

normal.en: The adjective trendy cuts the d and adds y.
normal.cn: 形容词 trendy 去掉 d 再加 y。

normal.en: A trendsetter sets the trend for others to follow.
normal.cn: trendsetter 设下潮流让旁人跟随。

normal.en: The plural is simply trends.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s：trends。

normal.en: Statistics made the word famous: a trend line on a chart.
normal.cn: 统计学让这个词流行：图表上的一条趋势线。

abstract.en: A coastline bending the same way for miles.
abstract.cn: 海岸线绵延数里朝同一方向弯。

abstract.en: Water finding one slope and staying with it.
abstract.cn: 水找到一面斜坡，就一路顺着它。

abstract.en: Many people turning their heads at the same moment.
abstract.cn: 许多人同时把头转向同一个方向。

examples.en: There is a clear trend toward smaller cars in the city.
examples.cn: 这座城市明显有偏爱小车的趋势。

examples.en: Rents in the old quarter have trended upward since spring.
examples.cn: 老城区的租金自春天以来趋于上涨。

examples.en: She never follows the fashion of the season.
examples.cn: 她从不追随当季的风尚。

dict_mnemonic.text: trend 里的 tren 一念就像「转」——大家往一个方向转，就成了潮流。

root: 古英语 trendan（转动），中古英语指海岸或河流的弯向，近代经统计学与时尚用语扩展为「趋势、潮流」；同族词有 trendy、trendsetter、trending。

sensesIntro.en: First the direction of a changing figure, then the fashion many follow, then the verb for moving that way.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是变化数字的方向，再是众人追随的时髦，最后是朝那个方向走的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bending line on a chart.
core.cn: 核心意象：图表上弯曲的线。

branches.en: The figure branch: numbers moving one way.
branches.cn: 数字分支：数字朝一个方向走。

branches.en: The fashion branch: many people turning together.
branches.cn: 时尚分支：许多人一起转向。

branches.en: The action branch: a course leaning one way.
branches.cn: 动作分支：走势朝一边倾。

branches.en: The chart branch: both are read on a line.
branches.cn: 图表分支：两者都在一条线上读出。

branches.en: The crowd branch: a habit becomes a general direction.
branches.cn: 人群分支：一种习惯变成总方向。

intro.en: Trend is a short Germanic stem that now builds compounds and derivatives in business and fashion.
intro.cn: trend 是短小的日耳曼语词干，如今在商业与时尚领域构成复合词与派生词。

latinIntro.en: The stem is not Latin; the Latin words below are cousins through shared Indo-European roots.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干并非拉丁语；下面的拉丁词只是通过共同印欧词根构成的远亲。

items.example: The stem works as noun and verb alike.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干既可作名词也可作动词。

items.example: It forms trendy, full of fashion.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trendy，满身时尚的。

items.example: It forms trending, popular right now.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trending，眼下正走红的。

items.example: The two words say what the person does.
items.exampleCN: 两个词直接说出这个人做的事。

items.example: Up names the direction of the line.
items.exampleCN: up 指明线的走向。

items.example: Down names the opposite direction.
items.exampleCN: down 指明相反的方向。

items.example: The line makes the direction visible.
items.exampleCN: 这条线让方向看得见。

items.example: Several trends appeared at once.
items.exampleCN: 数个趋势同时出现。

definition_zh: 试验；试用；审判；审讯
definition_en: a test of something to see whether it works, or the formal hearing of a case in a court
core_image: 一辆贴着彩条的车在试验场上绕圈，工程师盯着屏幕记数据
scene: 试验场上有一辆涂着彩条的车，工程师坐在场边的帐篷里看屏幕。The new engine is still on trial before it goes on sale.
sceneCN: 这里 trial 是「试验；试用」（第 1 个义项：为检验效果而进行的测试）；句意为这款新发动机在上市前仍在试用测试中。贴着彩条在场上绕圈的车，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: trial 的词根，义为「尝试；审判」
由 try 与 out 复合，义为「选拔；试用」
由 try 加 -ing 构成，义为「令人恼火的；艰难的」

senses.title: The test run
senses.definition: an act of testing something over a period to see how well it works
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内测试某物效果如何的行为
senses.example: The new engine is still on trial before it goes on sale.
senses.exampleCN: 这款新发动机在上市前仍在试用测试中。
senses.why: The ending -al turns the verb try into a noun, and the oldest sense is the testing of something.
senses.whyCN: -al 后缀把动词 try 变为名词，最古老的含义就是检验某物。

senses.title: The day in court
senses.definition: the formal examination of a case by a judge and often a jury
senses.definitionCN: 由法官及常设陪审团对案件进行的正式审理
senses.example: The trial lasted three weeks and ended with a verdict.
senses.exampleCN: 这场审判持续了三周，以裁决结束。
senses.why: A court also tests the facts of a case, so the legal hearing borrowed the same word as the engine test.
senses.whyCN: 法庭同样在检验案件的事实，于是庭审与发动机测试共用了同一个词。

senses.title: A hard testing time
senses.definition: a person or situation that tests your patience or strength
senses.definitionCN: 考验人耐心或承受力的人或处境
senses.example: Looking after three children alone was a real trial.
senses.exampleCN: 独自照料三个孩子真是一场考验。
senses.why: Anything that puts you under pressure is testing you, so hard days wear the same label.
senses.whyCN: 任何给你压力的事都在检验你，于是艰难的日子也挂上同一种标签。

senses.title: The person who is tested
senses.definition: a person taking part in a test to be chosen for a team or a job
senses.definitionCN: 参加测试以争取进入队伍或获得职位的人
senses.example: Three new players were on trial with the club in July.
senses.exampleCN: 七月有三名新球员在俱乐部试训。
senses.why: The noun can name a thing tested or a person tested, because both stand in front of a judge.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词既能指被检验的物，也能指被检验的人，因为两者都站在评判者面前。

intro.en: Trial is a noun made in English from the French verb trier, to sift or pick out, and it names whatever has been tested.
intro.cn: trial 是英语用来自法语动词 trier（筛、挑）造出的名词，指被检验过的东西。

items.en: Trier meant to sift grain or to sort things by quality.
items.cn: trier 意为筛谷物或按品质分类。

items.en: Tribulare and tritare lie behind French trier, all about rubbing or sorting.
items.cn: 法语 trier 的背后是 tribulare 与 tritare，都涉及摩擦或分选。

items.en: English formed trial on the French stem, first for the testing of metal and goods.
items.cn: 英语在法语词干上造出 trial，最初指检验金属与货物。

items.en: Law courts adopted the word for the hearing that tests a case.
items.cn: 法院借这个词指检验案情的庭审。

items.en: Everyday speech extended it to anything that tests a person.
items.cn: 日常语言把它扩展到任何考验人的事情。

note.en: The first group shows the try family, the second holds other words for tests and hearings.
note.cn: 第一组是 try 词族，第二组是其他表示测试与审理的词。

entries.definition: To make an attempt or test something.
Annoying and hard to bear.
A test to choose players or workers.
A check of quality or ability.
A session in which a case is examined.
A controlled attempt to find out something.

normalIntro.en: Trial is try with a thin -al added: what you get when you try something over and over.
normalIntro.cn: trial 就是 try 加一个轻薄的 -al：反复尝试之后得到的那件事。

normal.en: The y of try becomes i before the suffix: trial.
normal.cn: try 的 y 在词尾前变成 i：trial。

normal.en: Stand trial means you are being tested in court.
normal.cn: stand trial 意为在法庭上受检验。

normal.en: A trial period is time given to see if something works.
normal.cn: trial period 是检验一段时间看是否可行的期限。

normal.en: The plural only adds s: trials.
normal.cn: 复数只加 s：trials。

normal.en: A clinical trial tests a medicine on people.
normal.cn: clinical trial 是在人身上检验药物。

abstract.en: A marker line painted on a test track.
abstract.cn: 试验跑道上画的一条标线。

abstract.en: A small sample of cloth pulled between finger and thumb.
abstract.cn: 指尖搓过的一小块布样。

abstract.en: A long day that keeps asking how much you can carry.
abstract.cn: 漫长的一天，不断问你能承住多少。

examples.en: The drug is being tested in a large clinical trial.
examples.cn: 这种药正在一项大型临床试验中检验。

examples.en: She is standing trial for the theft of two paintings.
examples.cn: 她因盗窃两幅画而受审。

examples.en: The first month is a trial period without any cost.
examples.cn: 第一个月是免付费试用期。

dict_mnemonic.text: trial 里有 try——凡 trial 就是 try 出来的东西。

root: 由法语动词 trier（筛、挑）的词干加 -al 构成，源自中世纪拉丁语 tribulare、tritare，本义与筛选、摩擦有关；同族词有 try、trying、tryout。

sensesIntro.en: First the test of an object, then the test of a case in court, then any hard test of a person.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是检验物件，再是法庭上检验案情，最后是任何对人的艰难考验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a marked track and a ticking screen.
core.cn: 核心意象：画着标线的跑道与跳动的屏幕。

branches.en: The product branch: a thing tested before sale.
branches.cn: 产品分支：上市前被检验的东西。

branches.en: The court branch: a case tested by a judge.
branches.cn: 法庭分支：由法官检验的案件。

branches.en: The person branch: a day that tests you.
branches.cn: 人分支：考验你的一天。

branches.en: The testing branch: both asks whether it holds.
branches.cn: 检验分支：两者都在问它是否站得住。

branches.en: The strain branch: weighing a person or a fact.
branches.cn: 承重分支：称量一个人或一项事实。

intro.en: Trial is formed from the French verb stem tri plus the noun suffix -al, a pattern English still uses freely.
intro.cn: trial 由法语动词词干 tri 加名词后缀 -al 构成，这一构词法英语至今仍常用。

latinIntro.en: Latin tritare, to rub or grind, is behind the French stem, and the words below show the same origin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tritare（磨、擦）是法语词干的前身，下面的词显示同一来源。

items.example: The stem carries the act of sorting for quality.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干承载按品质分选的行动。

items.example: It turns trying into a trial.
items.exampleCN: 它把尝试变成一次试验。

items.example: The verb names the bare action.
items.exampleCN: 动词命名纯粹的动作。

items.example: The participle became an adjective of strain.
items.exampleCN: 分词变成了表示煎熬的形容词。

items.example: The noun names what was tried.
items.exampleCN: 名词指被试验的那件事。

items.example: Several trials produced the same answer.
items.exampleCN: 几次试验得出同样的答案。

items.meaning: a public test for a place
items.example: Out marks a full attempt to the end.
items.exampleCN: out 标记把事情试到底。

items.example: Re adds another attempt after a failure.
items.exampleCN: re 表示失败后再来一次。

definition_zh: 旅行；旅程；绊倒；（药物引起的）迷幻体验
definition_en: a journey to a place and back, especially a short one, or an act of catching your foot and stumbling
core_image: 一列小火车似的巴士沿山路开进雾里，车窗上映着笑脸
scene: 周末清晨，一群人背着包上了开往山里的巴士。We took a trip to the mountains and stayed for two nights.
sceneCN: 这里 trip 是「旅行；旅程」（第 1 个义项：去某地再回来的行程，尤指短途）；句意为我们去山里旅行，住了两晚。清晨背包装车的那群人，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 trip 加 -er 构成，义为「（短途）游客」
由 trip 加 -ing 构成，义为「轻快的（步伐）」
以 tri-（三）构成，义为「三脚架」

senses.title: Out and back
senses.definition: a journey to a place, especially a short one that ends at home
senses.definitionCN: 到某地的一次行程，尤指以回家告终的短途
senses.example: We took a trip to the mountains and stayed for two nights.
senses.exampleCN: 我们去山里旅行了一趟，住了两晚。
senses.why: The word may come from an old verb for skipping, because a short journey is a lively hop out and back.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可能源自意为「轻跳」的旧动词，因为短途出行就是轻快地跳出再回来。

senses.title: The foot catches
senses.definition: to catch your foot on something and lose balance
senses.definitionCN: 脚被某物挡住而失去平衡
senses.example: He tripped over the edge of the carpet.
senses.exampleCN: 他被地毯的边角绊了一下。
senses.why: A hop that goes wrong becomes a stumble, and this literal sense still lives in the verb.
senses.whyCN: 跳得不好就成了踉跄，这一字面含义仍留在动词里。

senses.title: Setting something off
senses.definition: to cause a switch or a machine to start working
senses.definitionCN: 使开关或机器开始运作
senses.example: A loose wire tripped the alarm at midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 一根松动的电线在半夜触发了警报。
senses.why: A light foot catches a lever, and the mechanism starts, so machines also get tripped.
senses.whyCN: 轻脚一碰钩住杠杆，机构便启动，于是机器也会被 trip。

senses.title: A single outbound turn
senses.definition: one leg of a journey, counted as a single unit
senses.definitionCN: 行程中的一段，按一个单位计数
senses.example: The truck made four trips between the quarry and the site.
senses.exampleCN: 卡车在采石场和工地之间跑了四趟。
senses.why: When journeys are counted, each single run out and back becomes one trip by itself.
senses.whyCN: 当行程被计数时，每一趟出去再回来本身就成了一次 trip。

intro.en: Trip is a short English word of uncertain origin, probably connected with old verbs for skipping and stumbling.
intro.cn: trip 是来源不确定的短小英语词，可能与表示跳跃与踉跄的旧动词有关。

items.en: No sure source is known; it appears in the Middle English period as a verb of light movement.
items.cn: 确切来源不明；它在中古英语时期已作为表示轻快动作的动词出现。

items.en: To trippen meant to step lightly, and also to stumble on a stone.
items.cn: trippen 意为轻步走，也指在石头上踉跄。

items.en: A short sea voyage was called a trip in the early modern period.
items.cn: 近代早期，一段短途海上航程被称作 a trip。

items.en: By the nineteenth century a trip covered any short journey by train or coach.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，trip 已指任何乘火车或马车的短途行程。

items.en: The machine sense, tripping a switch, grew out of the same light touch.
items.cn: 触发开关的机械义同样出自那次轻碰。

note.en: The first group shares the trip stem and sound, the second holds words for journeys and stumbles.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trip 的词干与读音，第二组收表示旅程与踉跄的词。

entries.definition: A person on a short trip.
Moving lightly or catching the foot.
Stumbled or set off a device.
Travel from one place to another.
A short pleasure trip with others.
To catch the foot and nearly fall.

normalIntro.en: Trip is a tiny word with two lives: a small hop out somewhere, and a small hop that goes wrong.
normalIntro.cn: trip 这个词很小，却有两重生活：轻快地跳出去一趟，以及轻跳失手的一下。

normal.en: Take a trip means go out and come back.
normal.cn: take a trip 意为出去再回来。

normal.en: Past forms double the p: tripped, tripping.
normal.cn: 过去式双写 p：tripped、tripping。

normal.en: Trip over is the everyday stumble phrase.
normal.cn: trip over 是日常的绊倒说法。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: trips.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s：trips。

normal.en: Tripper turns the word into a person.
normal.cn: tripper 把这个词变成一个人。

abstract.en: A duffel bag by the door on a Friday night.
abstract.cn: 周五晚上门口的一只行李包。

abstract.en: A stone on a path you did not look at.
abstract.cn: 路上你没留意的一块石头。

abstract.en: A light foot catching a wire and waking the alarm.
abstract.cn: 轻脚绊到一根线，把警报唤醒。

examples.en: The bus leaves before dawn for a day trip to the lake.
examples.cn: 去湖边一日游的大巴在天亮前出发。

examples.en: She tripped on the last stair and dropped her keys.
examples.cn: 她在最后一级台阶绊了一下，钥匙掉在地上。

examples.en: Our trip to the coast was cut short by the storm.
examples.cn: 我们的海边之行被暴风雨提前中断。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹蒲」——吹着蒲公英去旅行；脚下一绊，就是 trip 的另一义。

root: 来源不确定（中古英语 trippen 意为轻步走、踉跄），近代扩展出「短途旅行」与「触发装置」两义；同族词有 tripper、tripping、tripped。

sensesIntro.en: First the short journey, then the stumble, then the small touch that sets a device going.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是短途旅行，再是踉跄，最后是那点轻碰把装置启动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bag by the door and a stone on the path.
core.cn: 核心意象：门口的行囊与路上的一块石头。

branches.en: The journey branch: a short way out and back.
branches.cn: 旅程分支：短程出去再回来。

branches.en: The body branch: a foot catching and slipping.
branches.cn: 身体分支：脚绊住并滑开。

branches.en: The mechanism branch: a light touch starts a machine.
branches.cn: 机械分支：轻轻一碰让机器启动。

branches.en: The hop branch: both grew from a light skip.
branches.cn: 跳跃分支：两者都出自轻跳。

branches.en: The trigger branch: feet and levers both catch.
branches.cn: 触发分支：脚与杠杆都会被钩住。

intro.en: Trip is a free stem of uncertain origin that easily takes endings such as -er and -ing.
intro.cn: trip 是来源不明的自由词干，可以方便地加上 -er、-ing 等词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the journey words below, which are cousins rather than direct ancestors.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的旅程词汇出自拉丁语，它们只是远亲而非直接祖先。

items.example: The stem also works as a verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干也能作动词。

items.example: It forms tripper, a short-trip visitor.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tripper，短途游客。

items.example: It forms tripping, moving lightly.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tripping，轻快行进的。

items.example: Two trips in one month were too many.
items.exampleCN: 一个月两次旅行太多了。

items.example: The p doubles before the ending.
items.exampleCN: 加词尾前 p 要双写。

items.example: Day fixes the length of the outing.
items.exampleCN: day 限定了出游的长度。

items.example: Business names the reason for the journey.
items.exampleCN: business 说明出行的理由。

items.example: The same letters open a word about three feet.
items.exampleCN: 同样的字母开头，构成了关于三只脚的词。

definition_zh: 热带的；炎热的（如热带般闷热的）
definition_en: belonging to the hot regions near the equator, or as hot and humid as those regions
core_image: 雨林里巨大的叶片垂着水珠，藤蔓从高树一直挂下来
scene: 雨林的午后，空气闷得像浸过水，宽大的叶子仍在滴水。The garden is full of tropical plants from South America.
sceneCN: 这里 tropical 是「热带的」（第 1 个义项：属于赤道附近炎热地区的）；句意为园中满是来自南美的热带植物。雨林里滴水的大叶和藤蔓，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 tropical 去掉后缀构成，义为「热带地区」
tropical 的词根名词，义为「回归线；热带」
由 sub-（副）与 tropical 复合，义为「亚热带的」

senses.title: Near the equator
senses.definition: belonging to the belt of the earth that lies near the equator and is always warm
senses.definitionCN: 属于地球赤道附近终年温暖的那一带
senses.example: The garden is full of tropical plants from South America.
senses.exampleCN: 园中满是来自南美的热带植物。
senses.why: Greek tropos, a turn, named the line where the sun turns back, and the whole belt took that name.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 tropos（转向）命名了太阳折返的那条线，整条地带也随之得名。

senses.title: Weather that feels like it
senses.definition: used of weather that is hot and damp even far from the equator
senses.definitionCN: 形容即使远离赤道也又热又潮的天气
senses.example: The air was tropical for a week after the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 雨后有一周空气都闷热得像热带。
senses.why: A heat that hangs and does not dry out copies the feeling of the equator, so any such day may be called tropical.
senses.whyCN: 那种悬着不散的湿热复制了赤道的感觉，于是这样的日子也被称作 tropical。

intro.en: Tropical belongs to the noun tropic, which comes from the Greek tropos, a turn, because the sun appears to turn back at the tropics.
intro.cn: tropical 属于名词 tropic，后者来自希腊语 tropos（转向），因为太阳在回归线处看起来折返。

items.en: Tropos meant a turn or a way of turning, from trepein, to turn.
items.cn: tropos 意为转向或转向的方式，出自 trepein（转）。

items.en: The adjective tropicus was used of the solstice, the sun's turning point.
items.cn: 形容词 tropicus 原用于至日，即太阳折返的时刻。

items.en: The two tropics were named as the lines where the sun turns back each year.
items.cn: 两条回归线得名于太阳每年折返之处。

items.en: English tropic named the lines, and tropical described the whole hot belt between them.
items.cn: 英语用 tropic 指这两条线，tropical 形容它们之间整条炎热的地带。

items.en: The word then extended to hot, damp weather anywhere and to storms born in that belt.
items.cn: 这个词进而扩展指任何地方的湿热天气与诞生于该地带的风暴。

note.en: The first group shares the trop stem, the second holds other words for heat and climate zones.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trop 词干，第二组收其他表示炎热与气候区的词。

entries.definition: The hot belt around the equator.
Either of the two turning lines of the sun.
Just outside the tropics.
Of the line around the middle of the earth.
Hot and damp in a heavy way.
Carrying a lot of water in the air.

normalIntro.en: Tropical is tropic plus -al, and tropic comes from a word for turning, because the sun turns back at those lines.
normalIntro.cn: tropical 是 tropic 加 -al，而 tropic 出自表示「转」的词，因为太阳在那些线上折返。

normal.en: Trop means turn, so the tropics are where the sun turns back.
normal.cn: trop 意为转，所以热带是太阳折返的地方。

normal.en: The adjective simply adds -al to tropic.
normal.cn: 形容词只是在 tropic 后加 -al。

normal.en: The tropics is always plural for the region itself.
normal.cn: 指整个地区时 tropics 总是复数。

normal.en: Sub in front gives subtropical, just outside the belt.
normal.cn: 前面加 sub 得 subtropical，就在那带之外。

normal.en: Tropical fish live in warm water, not in the sea of the far north.
normal.cn: tropical fish 生活在温暖的水里，不在北方远海。

abstract.en: A leaf so large it holds a small pool.
abstract.cn: 一片大得能盛一小池水的叶子。

abstract.en: Air that feels like warm wet cloth on the face.
abstract.cn: 像热湿布贴在脸上的空气。

abstract.en: Vines hanging straight down from the high canopy.
abstract.cn: 藤蔓从高处树冠笔直垂下。

examples.en: Tropical rainforests hold more species than any other place on land.
examples.cn: 热带雨林所含物种比陆地上任何地方都多。

examples.en: Bananas and mangoes are examples of tropical fruit.
examples.cn: 香蕉和芒果都是热带水果。

examples.en: The coast was hit by a tropical storm in August.
examples.cn: 海岸在八月遭到一场热带风暴袭击。

dict_mnemonic.text: trop（转）＋ ical——太阳在这里折返，所以终年炎热，就是热带的。

root: 由 tropic 加 -al 构成，源自希腊语 tropē、tropos（转向）与拉丁语 tropicus，本指太阳折返的至日与回归线，后指其间炎热地带；同族词有 tropics、tropic、subtropical。

sensesIntro.en: First the belt near the equator, then the heavy heat that feels like it.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是赤道附近那条地带，再是像那条地带一样的闷热。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dripping leaf in the rainforest.
core.cn: 核心意象：雨林里滴水的宽叶。

branches.en: The geography branch: plants and animals of the belt.
branches.cn: 地理分支：那条地带的动植物。

branches.en: The weather branch: heat that hangs and will not dry.
branches.cn: 天气分支：悬着不散的湿热。

branches.en: The sunlight branch: both come from a high warm sun.
branches.cn: 阳光分支：两者都来自高悬的暖阳。

branches.en: The storm branch: storms born over warm seas.
branches.cn: 风暴分支：出生在暖海上的风暴。

branches.en: The imagination branch: any day can feel tropical.
branches.cn: 想象分支：任何一天都能感觉像热带。

intro.en: Tropical joins the Greek stem trop, a turn, with the adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: tropical 把希腊词干 trop（转向）与形容词后缀 -al 结合起来。

latinIntro.en: The Greek root trepein, to turn, reached English through Latin tropicus, and the turning words below share it.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词根 trepein（转）经拉丁语 tropicus 进入英语，下面的「转」类词与它同源。

items.example: The stem explains the sun turning back.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干解释了太阳的折返。

items.example: It forms tropic, of the turning line.

items.exampleCN: 这个地区用复数命名。

items.exampleCN: sub 标出紧邻在外的一带。

items.example: The adjective describes weather and life.
