definition_zh: 卡车；货车；手推车；用卡车运送
definition_en: a large road vehicle with a strong body for carrying goods, or a small cart pushed by hand
core_image: 一辆满载木箱的大卡车轰隆隆地驶过仓库门口
scene: 仓库门口的坡道上，一辆大车正缓缓倒进来，后厢门放平搭在地上。A truck loaded with boxes pulled into the yard before six.
sceneCN: 这里 truck 是「卡车；货车」（第 1 个义项：在公路上运货的大型车辆）；句意为一辆装满箱子的卡车六点前开进院子。坡道上缓缓倒车的那个大家伙，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 truck 加 -er 构成，义为「卡车司机」
由 truck 与 load 复合，义为「一卡车的量」
由 truck 加 -ing 构成，义为「卡车运输业」

senses.title: The big goods carrier
senses.definition: a large motor vehicle built to carry heavy loads along roads
senses.definitionCN: 在公路上运送重货的大型机动车
senses.example: A truck loaded with boxes pulled into the yard before six.
senses.exampleCN: 一辆装满箱子的卡车六点前开进院子。
senses.why: The word began as a small wheel and grew into the machine that rides on those wheels.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指一只小轮子，后来长成了靠那些轮子行走的机器。

senses.title: The small hand cart
senses.definition: a low open cart with wheels, pushed by hand or pulled by a person
senses.definitionCN: 带轮的低矮敞篷小车，用手推或拉
senses.example: He wheeled a truck of bricks across the yard.
senses.exampleCN: 他用一辆手推车把砖推过院子。
senses.why: Older English used truck for a small wheel, so the little cart named itself after its wheels.
senses.whyCN: 早期英语用 truck 指小轮子，于是那辆小车是以它的轮子命名的。

senses.title: To move by truck
senses.definition: to carry goods in a truck from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 用卡车把货物从一处运到另一处
senses.example: The company trucks fresh vegetables to the city each night.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司每晚把新鲜蔬菜用卡车运到城里。
senses.why: Once the vehicle had a name, the verb simply followed: to truck goods is to move them by truck.
senses.whyCN: 车辆有了名字，动词就顺势而生：truck goods 就是用卡车运货。

intro.en: Truck probably comes through French from the Latin trochus, a wheel or hoop, and its first English sense was a small wheel.
intro.cn: truck 大概经法语来自拉丁语 trochus（轮、圈），它在英语里的第一个含义是「小轮子」。

items.en: Trokhos meant a wheel or a circular course.
items.cn: trokhos 意为轮子或环行的路径。

items.en: Trochus named an iron hoop used in games and, later, any wheel.
items.cn: trochus 指游戏用的铁圈，后来泛指轮子。

items.en: Troque named a pulley wheel or a small wooden wheel.
items.cn: troque 指滑轮或小木轮。

items.en: English truck first meant a small wheel, then the low cart that ran on them.
items.cn: 英语 truck 先指小轮，再指靠这些小轮行走的低矮车。

items.en: With engines the cart grew into the heavy road vehicle of today.
items.cn: 有了发动机，那辆车长成了今天公路上的重型车辆。

note.en: The first group shares the truck stem, the second holds other words for goods vehicles.
note.cn: 第一组共享 truck 词干，第二组收其他表示载货车与运货的词。

entries.definition: A person who drives a truck.
As much as a truck can carry.
The business of moving goods by road.
The British word for a large goods vehicle.
A smaller covered vehicle for light loads.
A small vehicle with wheels, often pulled.

normalIntro.en: Truck is a short, blunt word that sounds like the noise of a heavy vehicle on a rough road.
normalIntro.cn: truck 短促粗硬，听起来就像重型车在颠簸路上的声音。

normal.en: The past forms add a k sound: trucked, trucking.
normal.cn: 过去式加 k 音：trucked、trucking。

normal.en: Trucker is the driver, trucking is the business.
normal.cn: trucker 是司机，trucking 是运输业。

normal.en: A truckload says how much the vehicle can hold.
normal.cn: truckload 说明这辆车能装多少。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: trucks.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s：trucks。

normal.en: The first English meaning was simply a small wheel.
normal.cn: 英语里最早的含义只是「小轮子」。

abstract.en: A back door lowering to the ground like a drawbridge.
abstract.cn: 后门像吊桥一样放下来。

abstract.en: Dust rising behind a heavy load on a dirt road.
abstract.cn: 土路上重车后扬起的尘土。

abstract.en: A single wheel rolling on its own before any cart exists.
abstract.cn: 在有车之前，一只轮子独自滚动。

examples.en: The truck stopped by the river to unload the sand.
examples.cn: 卡车在河边停下卸沙。

examples.en: Farmers truck their milk to the factory before sunrise.
examples.cn: 农民在日出前用卡车把牛奶运到工厂。

examples.en: A truck of hay stood by the barn door.
examples.cn: 一辆装满干草的手推车停在谷仓门口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳克」——大车一开过来，路面被戳得咔咔响，就是卡车。

root: 可能经法语 troque 来自拉丁语 trochus（铁圈、轮子），再上溯希腊语 trokhos；本义「小轮子」，后指手推车、载货卡车；同族词有 trucker、truckload、trucking。

sensesIntro.en: First the heavy road vehicle, then the little hand cart, then the verb of carrying by truck.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是重型公路车辆，再是小手推车，最后是用卡车运送的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a back door lowering onto a loading ramp.
core.cn: 核心意象：后门放下搭到装卸坡上。

branches.en: The vehicle branch: the engine replaced the horse.
branches.cn: 车辆分支：发动机取代了马。

branches.en: The cart branch: the small wheel still survives.
branches.cn: 小车分支：小轮子的影子仍在。

branches.en: The action branch: moving goods by road.
branches.cn: 动作分支：沿公路运送货物。

branches.en: The road branch: the truck and its work share one picture.
branches.cn: 公路分支：车与它的活儿共用一幅画。

branches.en: The wheel branch: both still run on wheels.
branches.cn: 轮子分支：两者都靠轮子行走。

intro.en: Truck is a short free stem that takes -er, -ing and compound forms easily.
intro.cn: truck 是短小的自由词干，容易接 -er、-ing 以及复合形式。

latinIntro.en: The Greek and Latin source trochus, a wheel, also gives the technical words below.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语与拉丁语来源 trochus（轮子）还生出下面的技术词。

items.example: The stem works as noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干可作名词与动词。

items.example: It forms trucker, the driver.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trucker，司机。

items.example: It forms trucking, the road freight trade.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trucking，公路货运业。

items.meaning: as much as can be carried
items.example: It forms truckload, one full load.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 truckload，一整车的量。

items.example: Trucks queued at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 卡车在门口排队。

items.example: The stone was trucked from the quarry.
items.exampleCN: 石头是从采石场用卡车运来的。

items.example: They are trucking the harvest south.
items.exampleCN: 他们正把收成运往南方。

items.example: Fire names the job of the vehicle.
items.exampleCN: fire 说明这辆车的工作。

definition_zh: 真实的；确实的；真正的；忠实的
definition_en: matching the facts, real rather than imagined, or faithful to a person or a promise
core_image: 一把校准好的尺子与墙上标出的刻度严丝合缝
scene: 工作台上放着一根木尺，工匠把它贴到墙上核对刻度是否对得上。Every word in his report proved to be true.
sceneCN: 这里 true 是「真实的；确实的」（第 1 个义项：与事实相符的）；句意为他报告中的每个字都被证明是真的。尺子贴墙核对刻度，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 true 加 -th 构成，义为「真相；真理」
由 true 加 -ly 构成，义为「真正地；真诚地」
由 truth 加 -ful 构成，义为「诚实的；真实的」

senses.title: Matching the facts
senses.definition: agreeing with what actually happened or exists
senses.definitionCN: 与实际发生或存在的情况相符
senses.example: Every word in his report proved to be true.
senses.exampleCN: 他报告中的每个字都被证明是真的。
senses.why: The old English word meant faithful and firm, and something faithful to the facts is simply true.
senses.whyCN: 古英语中这个词意为忠信、牢固，而忠于事实的东西自然就是真的。

senses.title: Real, not imitated
senses.definition: used of something that deserves its name completely
senses.definitionCN: 用于完全配得上其名称的事物
senses.example: This is a true copy of the original page.
senses.exampleCN: 这是原页的真实副本。
senses.why: If a copy keeps faith with the original, it can be called true, and so the word reached the sense of genuine.
senses.whyCN: 如果副本忠于原件，就能称作 true，于是这个词也延伸出「名副其实」的意思。

senses.title: Faithful to a person
senses.definition: staying loyal to a friend, a promise, or a cause
senses.definitionCN: 对朋友、承诺或事业保持忠诚
senses.example: A true friend tells you what you need to hear.
senses.exampleCN: 真正的朋友会说出你需要听的话。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, the fixed and steady heart that the old word first named.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：那个古词最初命名的是固定不移的心。

intro.en: True is one of the oldest English words, and its earliest sense was faithful or firm rather than factual.
intro.cn: true 是英语最古老的词之一，最早的意思是忠信、牢固，而不是「合乎事实」。

items.en: The Germanic root treuwaz named that which is firm, loyal, and trustworthy.
items.cn: 日耳曼语词根 treuwaz 指牢固、忠实、可信赖之物。

items.en: Old English treowe meant faithful to a lord or a promise.
items.cn: 古英语 treowe 意为对领主或承诺的忠信。

items.en: Middle English extended it to statements that keep faith with the facts.
items.cn: 中古英语把它扩展到与事实相符的陈述。

items.en: The adjective also took the sense of genuine, as in a true copy.
items.cn: 这个形容词也取得「真正的」意义，如 a true copy。

items.en: Come true and hold true keep the old idea of a thing staying firm.
items.cn: come true 与 hold true 保留了事物稳固不移的旧意。

note.en: The first group shares the tru stem, the second holds other words about accuracy and honesty.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tru 词干，第二组收其他表示准确与诚实的词。

entries.definition: That which agrees with the facts.
In a real and honest way.
Telling the facts honestly.
Correct in every detail.
Real and not a copy.
Staying loyal to a person or promise.

normalIntro.en: True keeps the old idea of being firm and faithful, and facts are simply what a word stays faithful to.
normalIntro.cn: true 保留着「牢固、忠实」的古意，而事实不过是一个词所忠于的对象。

normal.en: The silent e drops before -ly: truly.
normal.cn: 加 -ly 前去掉不发音的 e：truly。

normal.en: True becomes truth with -th, like warm and warmth.
normal.cn: true 加 -th 变 truth，就像 warm 加 -th 变 warmth。

normal.en: Come true means the wish has become real.
normal.cn: come true 意为愿望成了真。

normal.en: The vowel is long, like the sound in food.
normal.cn: 元音是长音，像 food 里的音。

normal.en: Hold true means the rule still stands.
normal.cn: hold true 意为这条规则仍然成立。

abstract.en: A ruler laid along a wall and matching the marks exactly.
abstract.cn: 一把尺贴墙，与刻线完全对齐。

abstract.en: A promise kept long after everyone stopped watching.
abstract.cn: 没有人再看着时仍然守住的承诺。

abstract.en: A photograph and the face it shows, with no gap between.
abstract.cn: 一张照片与它呈现的脸，二者没有缝隙。

examples.en: It is true that the bridge was closed for a month.
examples.cn: 那座桥确实关闭了一个月。

examples.en: Her dream of seeing the sea finally came true.
examples.cn: 她看海的心愿终于实现了。

examples.en: He remained loyal to the original design in every detail.
examples.cn: 他在每个细节上都忠于最初的设计。

dict_mnemonic.text: true 与 tree 同源——像树一样笔直立着不动摇，就是真实、忠实。

root: 古英语 treowe（忠信、牢固），来自日耳曼语词根 treuwaz，与 tree、truth 同源；同族词有 truth、truly、truthful。

sensesIntro.en: First what agrees with the facts, then what is genuine, then the old sense of loyalty.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是与事实相符，再是名副其实，最后回到最古老的忠诚之义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ruler matching the marks exactly.
core.cn: 核心意象：尺子与刻线严丝合缝。

branches.en: The fact branch: words that agree with events.
branches.cn: 事实分支：与事件相符的话。

branches.en: The genuine branch: a thing worthy of its name.
branches.cn: 真品分支：配得上名字的东西。

branches.en: The loyalty branch: a heart that does not move.
branches.cn: 忠诚分支：不会动摇的心。

branches.en: The test branch: both are checked against a standard.
branches.cn: 检验分支：两者都要对照标准查。

branches.en: The old root branch: faithfulness and truth share one stem.
branches.cn: 古词根分支：忠信与真实共用一个词干。

intro.en: True is a short Germanic stem, and English builds truth and truly on it with two old endings.
intro.cn: true 是短小的日耳曼语词干，英语用两个古老词尾在上面造出 truth 与 truly。

latinIntro.en: No Latin ancestor exists for true; the Latin words below are distant cousins of the same idea.
latinIntro.cn: true 没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁词只是同一概念的远亲。

items.example: The stem serves as the adjective itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干本身就是形容词。

items.example: It forms truth, the state of being true.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 truth，真实的状态。

items.example: It forms truly, in a true way.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 truly，真实地。

items.example: It forms truthful from truth.
items.exampleCN: 它由 truth 构成 truthful。

items.example: Un reverses the quality.
items.exampleCN: un 逆转这个性质。

items.example: The noun names the fact itself.
items.exampleCN: 名词指事实本身。

items.example: The e drops before the suffix.
items.exampleCN: 加词尾前 e 要去掉。

items.example: The adjective describes a person.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述人。

definition_zh: 真正地；确实；真诚地；非常
definition_en: in a real or sincere way, used for emphasis, or at the end of a polite letter
core_image: 信纸最下方刚写完的一句短话，墨还没干
scene: 案头一封信写到最后一行，写的人在落款前停了停。I am truly sorry for the trouble I caused.
sceneCN: 这里 truly 是「真诚地；真正地」（第 1 个义项：以真实、诚恳的方式）；句意为我为自己造成的麻烦真诚地道歉。信末落款前那片刻停顿，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: truly 的词根，义为「真实的」
由 true 加 -th 构成，义为「真相」
由 truth 加 -ful 构成，义为「诚实的」

senses.title: In a real way
senses.definition: in a way that is real and not merely claimed
senses.definitionCN: 以真实而非仅口头声称的方式
senses.example: I am truly sorry for the trouble I caused.
senses.exampleCN: 我为自己造成的麻烦真诚地道歉。
senses.why: The adverb takes the adjective true and adds manner: whatever is done in a true way is done truly.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词取形容词 true 并加上方式：以真实的方式去做，就是 truly 地做。

senses.title: With a sincere heart
senses.definition: with honest feeling, without pretence
senses.definitionCN: 带着真实的情感，毫不做作
senses.example: She thanked us truly, without any show.
senses.exampleCN: 她真心实意地谢我们，没有一点做作。
senses.why: The oldest sense of true was faithful, and the adverb keeps that warmth of a loyal heart.
senses.whyCN: true 最古老的意思是忠信，副词也保留了这颗忠诚之心的温度。

senses.title: As a strong emphasis
senses.definition: used before an adjective to mean really and extremely
senses.definitionCN: 放在形容词前表示「真的很、极其」
senses.example: The view from the ridge is truly magnificent.
senses.exampleCN: 从山脊望出去的景色确实壮丽。
senses.why: When a word must be believed strongly, truly steps in to underline it.
senses.whyCN: 当一句话需要被强烈相信时，truly 就站出来给它加下划线。

senses.title: The letter ending
senses.definition: a polite closing before a signature in a formal letter
senses.definitionCN: 正式信件署名前的礼貌结束语
senses.example: Yours truly, M. Hale.
senses.exampleCN: 您诚挚的，M. 黑尔。
senses.why: Letter writers wanted a closing that promised honesty, and this adverb offered exactly that.
senses.whyCN: 写信的人想要一句承诺诚实的结束语，这个副词正好提供了它。

intro.en: Truly is simply true plus the adverb ending -ly, with the silent e dropped in the spelling.
intro.cn: truly 就是 true 加上副词词尾 -ly，拼写时去掉了不发音的 e。

items.en: The root treuwaz meant firm and loyal, the seed of both true and truth.
items.cn: 词根 treuwaz 意为牢固、忠实，是 true 与 truth 的种子。

items.en: Old English had treowlice, meaning faithfully, already with the adverb ending.
items.cn: 古英语已有 treowlice，意为忠实地，当时就带着副词词尾。

items.en: The form settled as truly after the e was dropped before the suffix.
items.cn: 在词尾前去 e 之后，拼写固定为 truly。

items.en: The adverb grew into an intensifier, as in truly wonderful.
items.cn: 这个副词发展出强调用法，如 truly wonderful。

items.en: Yours truly became a standard closing in letters and later a joking name for oneself.
items.cn: Yours truly 成了信件的标准结束语，后来又成了自称的戏谑说法。

note.en: The first group shares the tru stem, the second holds other adverbs of truth and sincerity.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tru 词干，第二组收其他表示真实与诚恳的副词。

entries.definition: Agreeing with the facts.
That which agrees with the facts.
In an honest way.
In fact, or used for emphasis.
With honest feeling.
In a real and true manner.

normalIntro.en: Remember the spelling: truly has no e, though true does.
normalIntro.cn: 记住拼写：truly 里没有 e，而 true 里有。

normal.en: Drop the e before -ly: true becomes truly.
normal.cn: 加 -ly 前去 e：true 变 truly。

normal.en: Yours truly signs the end of a formal letter.
normal.cn: Yours truly 用在正式信件末尾署名。

normal.en: Truly before an adjective simply means very.
normal.cn: 放在形容词前，truly 就是「非常」。

normal.en: The word keeps the old sense of faithful.
normal.cn: 这个词保留忠实的古义。

normal.en: It is often used with sorry and grateful.
normal.cn: 它常与 sorry、grateful 连用。

abstract.en: A pen resting on the last line of a letter.
abstract.cn: 搁在信末一行上的笔。

abstract.en: A voice without any acting in it.
abstract.cn: 一个不带任何表演的声音。

abstract.en: A word underlined twice on a page.
abstract.cn: 纸上被划了两道线的词。

examples.en: I truly believe she meant no harm.
examples.cn: 我确实相信她并无恶意。

examples.en: It was a truly beautiful morning after the rain.
examples.cn: 雨后是一个真正美丽的清晨。

examples.en: He said he was grateful, and he meant it sincerely.
examples.cn: 他说他很感激，而且说得真心实意。

dict_mnemonic.text: true＋ly，去掉 e——老老实实地做一件事，就是真正地、真诚地。

root: 由 true（古英语 treowe，忠信、牢固）加副词词尾 -ly 构成，古英语已有 treowlice；同族词有 true、truth、truthful。

sensesIntro.en: Real manner first, then sincere feeling, then emphasis, then the closing of a letter.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是真实的方式，再是诚恳的心意，然后是强调，最后是信末的结束语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pen on the last line of a letter.
core.cn: 核心意象：信末那行上的笔。

branches.en: The reality branch: done in a real way.
branches.cn: 真实分支：以真实的方式做到。

branches.en: The sincerity branch: feeling without pretence.
branches.cn: 诚恳分支：没有做作的情感。

branches.en: The emphasis branch: underlining a word.
branches.cn: 强调分支：给一个词加下划线。

branches.en: The letter branch: a promise of honesty before a name.
branches.cn: 信件分支：名字之前的一句诚实承诺。

branches.en: The tone branch: both speak to a reader with respect.
branches.cn: 语气分支：两者都以敬意对读者说话。

intro.en: Truly is the stem tru plus the adverb ending -ly, a very common English pattern.
intro.cn: truly 是词干 tru 加副词词尾 -ly，这是英语中最常见的构词模式之一。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic, but the adverb ending itself came into English through Latin models.
latinIntro.cn: 词干来自日耳曼语，但副词词尾本身是借拉丁语范式进入英语的。

items.example: The stem is the adjective without its final e.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干就是去掉末尾 e 的形容词。

items.example: It turns the adjective into an adverb.
items.exampleCN: 它把形容词变成副词。

items.example: The adjective keeps its e.
items.exampleCN: 形容词保留 e。

items.example: The suffix names the state.
items.exampleCN: 词尾命名这种状态。

items.example: The adverb drops the e.
items.exampleCN: 这个副词去掉了 e。

items.example: The prefix denies the quality.
items.exampleCN: 前缀否定这种性质。

items.example: The suffix means full of.
items.exampleCN: 词尾意为「充满」。

items.example: The old root of firmness survives here.
items.exampleCN: 「牢固」的古词根仍留在这里。

definition_zh: 小号；喇叭；号声；大声宣布
definition_en: a brass instrument with a bright high sound, or to announce something loudly
core_image: 一支铜号举向天空，喇叭口亮得能照出人脸
scene: 山头的风把旗子吹得笔直，一个少年举起手里的铜管准备吹响。A trumpet sounded from the hill before the race began.
sceneCN: 这里 trumpet 是「小号；喇叭」（第 1 个义项：声音明亮高亢的铜管乐器）；句意为比赛开始前山上响起了号声。少年举向天空的那支铜号，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 trumpet 加 -er 构成，义为「小号手」
由 trumpet 加 -ing 构成，义为「号声；大肆宣扬」
与 trumpet 音近的动词，义为「打出（王牌）」

senses.title: The bright brass horn
senses.definition: a brass instrument made of a long tube with a wide bell, played by blowing
senses.definitionCN: 由长管与宽喇叭口组成、靠吹奏发声的铜管乐器
senses.example: A trumpet sounded from the hill before the race began.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛开始前，山上响起了号声。
senses.why: The old French word trump named a horn made of a tube, and English made trumpet from its smaller form.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 trump 指用管子做成的号，英语用小称形式造出 trumpet。

senses.title: The voice of an elephant
senses.definition: the loud call of an elephant, like a horn blast
senses.definitionCN: 大象响亮的叫声，像一阵号声
senses.example: We heard an elephant trumpet across the water.
senses.exampleCN: 我们听见一头大象隔着水吼叫。
senses.why: A trumpet is loud and carries far, so the great call of an elephant borrowed its name.
senses.whyCN: 小号响亮且能传很远，于是大象的大叫也借用了它的名字。

senses.title: Announcing loudly
senses.definition: to make something known as widely and loudly as possible
senses.definitionCN: 尽可能广泛响亮地让某事为人所知
senses.example: The papers trumpeted the discovery of the sunken ship.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸大肆宣扬这艘沉船的发现。
senses.why: The instrument once called people to hear an announcement, so the verb now means shouting news.
senses.whyCN: 这种乐器曾把人们叫来听通告，于是动词如今意为大声传消息。

intro.en: Trumpet is a diminutive of the old French trump, the name of a long horn used to call and to announce.
intro.cn: trumpet 是古法语 trump 的小称形式，后者是用于召唤与宣告的长号的名字。

items.en: Trompe named a horn or a pipe, and the verb tromper meant to play such a horn.
items.cn: trompe 指号或管，动词 tromper 意为吹这种号。

items.en: The diminutive trumpet named a smaller, clearer horn used by soldiers and heralds.
items.cn: 小称 trumpet 指士兵与传令官使用的小而清亮的号。

items.en: English took the word as trumpet, both the instrument and its call.
items.cn: 英语以 trumpet 借入这个词，既指乐器也指号声。

items.en: The verb to trumpet, meaning to proclaim, grew out of the herald's use.
items.cn: 动词 trumpet 意为宣扬，出自传令官的用法。

items.en: Naturalists compared the elephant's call to a horn, giving a second noun sense.
items.cn: 博物学家把象叫比作号声，于是多了第二个名词义项。

note.en: The first group shares the trumpet stem, the second holds other brass and wind words.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trumpet 词干，第二组收其他铜管与吹奏乐器词。

entries.definition: A person who plays the trumpet.
The sound of a trumpet or a loud call.
To play a winning card.
A simple tube blown to make a call.
A small horn used for signals in an army.
A long brass instrument with a slide.

normalIntro.en: Trumpet is a small trumpet: the word starts like a blare and ends with a snapped -et.
normalIntro.cn: trumpet 就是小号的号：词头像吹响的一声，结尾是一个短促的 -et。

normal.en: The -et ending marks a smaller thing, as in pocket and booklet.
normal.cn: -et 结尾标记较小之物，如 pocket 与 booklet。

normal.en: A trumpeter is the player, the trumpet is the horn.
normal.cn: trumpeter 是吹的人，trumpet 是那把号。

normal.en: To trumpet news is to blow it out loud.
normal.cn: trumpet news 就是把消息大声吹出去。

normal.en: The past form simply adds ed: trumpeted.
normal.cn: 过去式直接加 ed：trumpeted。

normal.en: The elephant's trumpet needs no instrument at all.
normal.cn: 大象的 trumpet 根本不需要乐器。

abstract.en: A bright bell of brass pointed at the sky.
abstract.cn: 一支朝向天空的亮铜喇叭口。

abstract.en: A single high note crossing a valley.
abstract.cn: 一个高音越过山谷。

abstract.en: A voice that carries further than the room allows.
abstract.cn: 一个传出房间之外的声音。

examples.en: A trumpet and two drums opened the ceremony.
examples.cn: 一支小号和两面鼓拉开了典礼的序幕。

examples.en: Far off, an elephant trumpeted in the dark.
examples.cn: 远处，一头大象在黑暗中吼叫。

examples.en: The company trumpeted its success on every poster in town.
examples.cn: 这家公司在城里每张海报上宣扬自己的成功。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹喇叭」的那声「特郎」——trumpet 就是小号，一吹就响遍全山。

root: 古法语 trompe（号、管）的小称 trumpet，动词 tromper 意为吹号；同族词有 trumpeter、trumpeting、trump。

sensesIntro.en: First the instrument, then the elephant call that copies it, then the act of announcing loudly.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是乐器，再是模仿它的象吼，最后是大声宣告的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a brass bell pointed at the sky.
core.cn: 核心意象：朝向天空的铜喇叭口。

branches.en: The instrument branch: tube, breath, and bell.
branches.cn: 乐器分支：管、气息与喇叭口。

branches.en: The animal branch: a horn a body can grow.
branches.cn: 动物分支：身体自带的号。

branches.en: The announcing branch: a call becomes a claim.
branches.cn: 宣告分支：号声变成声明。

branches.en: The herald branch: the horn once gathered a crowd.
branches.cn: 传令分支：号角曾招来人群。

branches.en: The sound branch: both are loud and far-reaching.
branches.cn: 声音分支：两者都响亮而传得远。

intro.en: Trumpet is an Old French stem with a diminutive ending, and English adds -er and -ing around it.
intro.cn: trumpet 是带小称词尾的古法语词干，英语在它周围加了 -er 与 -ing。

latinIntro.en: The word is French rather than Latin, but the horn words below belong to the same sound world.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词出自法语而非拉丁语，但下面的号角词汇属于同一个声音世界。

items.example: The stem names the long tube itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干指长管本身。

items.example: It marks the smaller, brighter horn.
items.exampleCN: 它标记较小、较亮的号。

items.example: It forms trumpeter, the player.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trumpeter，吹奏者。

items.example: It forms trumpeting, the call.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trumpeting，号声。

items.example: The noun and the verb share one form.
items.exampleCN: 名词与动词同形。

items.example: Trumpets answered from both towers.
items.exampleCN: 两座塔上的号声互相应答。

items.example: They trumpeted the result at dawn.
items.exampleCN: 他们在黎明时宣布了结果。

items.example: The trumpeter raised the bell.
items.exampleCN: 号手举起了喇叭口。

definition_zh: 树干；躯干；（汽车）后备箱；大象的长鼻；大箱子
definition_en: the thick main stem of a tree, a person's body without the head and limbs, the luggage space of a car, or an elephant's long nose
core_image: 一棵老树的粗壮主干笔直立在草地上，上面分出许多枝
scene: 森林边缘立着一棵很老的树，裸露的主干比旁边的人还粗。The trunk of the old oak was wider than two men.
sceneCN: 这里 trunk 是「树干」（第 1 个义项：树木粗壮的主干）；句意为这棵老橡树的树干比两个人还宽。草地上那根粗壮笔直的树干，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: trunk 的复数，也指「（男式）泳裤」
由 trunk 加 -ful 构成，义为「一大箱之量」
由 trunk 加 -less 构成，义为「没有树干的」

senses.title: The main stem
senses.definition: the thick central stem of a tree, from which the branches grow
senses.definitionCN: 树木粗壮的主干，枝条从其上生出
senses.example: The trunk of the old oak was wider than two men.
senses.exampleCN: 这棵老橡树的树干比两个人还宽。
senses.why: Latin truncus meant the cut-off stem of a tree, and the branches were what had been trimmed away.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 truncus 指被截断的树干，被修去的正是枝条。

senses.title: The body without limbs
senses.definition: the main part of a human or animal body, without head, arms, or legs
senses.definitionCN: 人和动物除去头、四肢之外的主体部分
senses.example: He kept his trunk still and turned only his head.
senses.exampleCN: 他让躯干保持不动，只转过头。
senses.why: A body has a central column from which limbs branch, exactly as a tree has a stem and branches.
senses.whyCN: 身体有一根中央立柱，四肢像树枝一样从上面分出，与树干分枝完全一致。

senses.title: The car's storage space
senses.definition: the covered space at the back of a car for luggage
senses.definitionCN: 汽车后部放行李的带盖空间
senses.example: The bags were still in the trunk when we arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 我们到时行李还在后备箱里。
senses.why: Early travellers used a large chest, a trunk, and the car simply gave that chest a fixed home.
senses.whyCN: 早年旅人用一只大箱子，也就是 trunk，汽车只是给这只箱子安了固定的家。

senses.title: The elephant's long nose
senses.definition: the long flexible nose of an elephant
senses.definitionCN: 大象长而灵活可弯的鼻子
senses.example: The elephant lifted water with its trunk.
senses.exampleCN: 大象用鼻子吸水。
senses.why: The nose is a strong tube growing out of the face, so it borrows the word for a thick stem.
senses.whyCN: 这条鼻子是从脸上伸出的粗管，于是借用了粗壮主干的说法。

senses.title: The big travelling chest
senses.definition: a large box with a hinged lid, used for storing or carrying things
senses.definitionCN: 带翻盖的大型箱柜，用于存放或携带物品
senses.example: An old leather trunk stood at the foot of the bed.
senses.exampleCN: 床边放着一只旧皮箱。
senses.why: The word for a stem turned into the word for a box, because a trunk was once a hollowed log.
senses.whyCN: 树干一词变成了箱子的名称，因为早期的箱子就是一段掏空的木筒。

intro.en: Trunk comes from the Latin truncus, the stem of a tree with its branches cut off, and English extended it to bodies, boxes, and noses.
intro.cn: trunk 来自拉丁语 truncus，指被截去枝条的树干，英语把它扩展到躯干、箱子和象鼻。

items.en: Truncus meant maimed or cut short, as well as the stem left after pruning.
items.cn: truncus 意为被截断的，也指修剪后剩下的主干。

items.en: French tronc named the stem of a tree and the body of a person.
items.cn: 法语 tronc 指树干与人的躯干。

items.en: English trunk first named the body, then the hollow log used as a box.
items.cn: 英语 trunk 先指躯干，再指用作箱子的一段空木筒。

items.en: The word spread to the elephant's nose and later to a car's luggage space.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到象鼻，后来又指汽车的行李空间。

items.en: Trunks in the plural still name a short garment worn by swimmers.
items.cn: 复数形式 trunks 至今指游泳者穿的短裤。

note.en: The first group shares the trunk stem, the second holds other words for stems and bodies.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trunk 词干，第二组收其他表示主干与躯体的词。

entries.definition: Swimming shorts, or several chests.
As much as a trunk holds.
Having no trunk.
The long thin part of a plant above the root.
The human body without head and limbs.
A large strong box with a lid.

normalIntro.en: Trunk is one word with one idea carried far: a central thick body from which things branch or into which things are packed.
normalIntro.cn: trunk 一个词一条思路走得很远：中央的粗壮主体，枝条从它分出，东西往它里面装。

normal.en: A tree has a trunk on top, a car has one at the back.
normal.cn: 树的主干在上方，车的 trunk 在后方。

normal.en: Truncus in Latin meant cut short, the root of truncate.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 truncus 意为截短，是 truncate 的词根。

normal.en: The plural trunks can mean swimming shorts.
normal.cn: 复数 trunks 可以指泳裤。

normal.en: An elephant uses its trunk as a hand and a cup.
normal.cn: 大象把鼻子当手也当杯子用。

normal.en: Put the luggage in the trunk of the car.
normal.cn: 把行李放进汽车后备箱。

abstract.en: A bare column of bark rising out of the moss.
abstract.cn: 一根裸露的树皮柱从苔藓里立起。

abstract.en: A wooden chest with brass corners and a curved lid.
abstract.cn: 一只铜包角、弧盖的木箱。

abstract.en: A thick tube curling down to the water.
abstract.cn: 一根粗管弯下来伸向水面。

examples.en: Moss covered the trunk and the lower branches.
examples.cn: 青苔覆满了树干和下部的枝条。

examples.en: He swung the heavy case into the trunk of the car.
examples.cn: 他把沉重的箱子甩进汽车后备箱。

examples.en: The elephant curled its trunk around the small tree.
examples.cn: 大象用鼻子卷住那棵小树。

dict_mnemonic.text: trunk 从树的主干出发：人的躯干是主干，箱子是木筒，象鼻是粗管，后备箱是箱子。

root: 拉丁语 truncus（截短的、树干），经古法语 tronc 进入英语；同源词有 truncate、trunkful、trunkless。

sensesIntro.en: The tree stem opens the list, then the body, then the car space, the elephant nose, and the travelling chest.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是树干，再是躯干，然后是后备箱、象鼻与旅行大箱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick column of bark on the moss.
core.cn: 核心意象：苔藓上一根粗树皮柱。

branches.en: The plant branch: the stem that holds the crown.
branches.cn: 植物分支：撑起树冠的主干。

branches.en: The body branch: limbs branch from a centre.
branches.cn: 躯体分支：四肢从中央分开。

branches.en: The container branch: the hollow log became a box.
branches.cn: 容器分支：空木筒成了箱子。

branches.en: The animal branch: a tube that can hold water.
branches.cn: 动物分支：能盛水的管子。

branches.en: The shape branch: thick, strong, and central.
branches.cn: 形状分支：粗壮而居中。

intro.en: Trunk is a Latin stem taken whole into English, and the family grows with -s and -less.
intro.cn: trunk 是整体借入英语的拉丁词干，词族靠 -s 与 -less 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin truncus, cut short, also yields truncate and the words below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 truncus（截短）还生出 truncate 以及下面的词。

items.example: The stem carries the idea of what is left after cutting.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干承载被截后剩下的部分。

items.example: The noun names the central body.
items.exampleCN: 名词指中央的主体。

items.example: It forms trunks, several chests or shorts.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trunks，多只箱子或泳裤。

items.example: It forms trunkful, one full chest.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trunkful，一满箱。

items.example: It forms trunkless, without a stem.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trunkless，没有树干的。

items.example: The verb keeps the literal old meaning.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词保留了字面的古义。

items.example: The ending shows the result of cutting.
items.exampleCN: 词尾显示剪过的结果。

items.example: It describes a tree with a strong stem.
items.exampleCN: 它形容有粗壮树干的树。

definition_zh: 信任；信赖；相信；信托
definition_en: to believe that someone is honest and will not harm you, or a firm belief in a person or thing
core_image: 一个人把钥匙交到另一个人手里，手心稳稳托着
scene: 门口站着一位老人，把一串钥匙放进年轻邻居的掌心。She trusted her neighbour with the keys to the house.
sceneCN: 这里 trust 是「信任；信赖」（第 1 个义项：相信某人诚实、不会伤害你）；句意为她把房子的钥匙交给邻居保管，信任他。钥匙放进手心的那一刻，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 trust 与 worthy 复合，义为「值得信任的」
由 trust 加 -ful 构成，义为「轻信的；信任的」
由 dis-（否定）与 trust 复合，义为「不信任」

senses.title: Believing in a person
senses.definition: to believe that someone is honest and reliable
senses.definitionCN: 相信某人诚实可靠
senses.example: She trusted her neighbour with the keys to the house.
senses.exampleCN: 她把房子的钥匙交给邻居保管，信任他。
senses.why: The old word meant firmness and comfort, and to trust someone is to rest firmly on them.
senses.whyCN: 这个古词意为牢固与安心，而信任某人就是稳稳地靠在他身上。

senses.title: The firm belief itself
senses.definition: the feeling that you can depend on someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 觉得可以依靠某人或某物的感觉
senses.example: Years of work had built trust between the two teams.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的合作在两个团队之间建立了信任。
senses.why: The verb turned into a noun, naming the steady feeling that makes trusting possible.
senses.whyCN: 动词变成名词，命名那种让信任得以发生的稳固感觉。

senses.title: Money held for others
senses.definition: a legal arrangement in which one person holds property for another
senses.definitionCN: 由一人替另一人持有财产的法律安排
senses.example: The money was left in trust for the children.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔钱被委托保管，留给孩子们。
senses.why: If you trust someone, you may hand them your property to hold, and law gave that act a formal name.
senses.whyCN: 若你信任某人，你可能会把财产交给他保管，法律给这个行为起了正式的名字。

intro.en: Trust comes from the Old Norse traust, a word for help and firm support, and it is cousin to true.
intro.cn: trust 来自古诺斯语 traust，意为帮助与坚固的支撑，与 true 同源。

items.en: The root treuwaz meant firm and loyal, shared with true and truth.
items.cn: 词根 treuwaz 意为牢固、忠实，与 true、truth 共享。

items.en: Traust named confident hope and the help that made a person feel safe.
items.cn: traust 指有把握的期望，以及使人感到安全的那种帮助。

items.en: English took trust for the feeling that someone will not fail you.
items.cn: 英语借入 trust 表示「某人不会让你失望」的感觉。

items.en: Law developed the trust, a formal arrangement for holding property.
items.cn: 法律发展出 trust，即持有财产的正式安排。

items.en: Business names such as trust bank grew from that legal use.
items.cn: trust bank 之类的商业名称都出自这一法律用法。

note.en: The first group shares the trust stem, the second holds other words about belief and confidence.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trust 词干，第二组收其他表示相信与自信的词。

entries.definition: Deserving to be trusted.
Relied on over a long time.
A lack of trust.
To accept that something is true.
To depend on someone or something.
A firm feeling of certainty.

normalIntro.en: Trust begins like true and ends with a firm -st, the shape of a word that stands still.
normalIntro.cn: trust 以 true 的样子开头，结尾是坚硬的 -st，像个站着不动的词。

normal.en: The ending -st appears in firm words such as steadfast.
normal.cn: 结尾 -st 出现在 steadfast 这类表示稳固的词语里。

normal.en: The past form simply adds ed: trusted.
normal.cn: 过去式直接加 ed：trusted。

normal.en: Trust someone with something means put it in their hands.
normal.cn: trust someone with something 意为把它交到他手上。

normal.en: Distrust adds dis, the prefix of undoing.
normal.cn: distrust 加 dis，这是表示否定的前缀。

normal.en: A trust in law is money held for another person.
normal.cn: 法律上的 trust 是为他人保管的钱。

abstract.en: A bunch of keys placed in an open palm.
abstract.cn: 一串钥匙被放进摊开的手掌。

abstract.en: A rope tied off and held without looking.
abstract.cn: 一根系紧后不用看就握住的绳。

abstract.en: The quiet after someone says I will be there.
abstract.cn: 有人说「我会在」之后的那份安静。

examples.en: I trust her to keep the plan secret.
examples.cn: 我相信她会保守这个计划。

examples.en: Trust between the two sides took years to build.
examples.cn: 双方的信任用了几年才建立起来。

examples.en: The fund was set up in trust for the children.
examples.cn: 这笔基金以信托方式为孩子们设立。

dict_mnemonic.text: trust 与 true 同源——把心稳稳托住对方的真实，就是信任。

root: 古诺斯语 traust（帮助、坚固的支持），来自日耳曼语词根 treuwaz（牢固、忠实），与 true、truth 同源；同族词有 trustworthy、trustful、distrust。

sensesIntro.en: First the act of believing in someone, then the steady feeling itself, then the legal arrangement that feeling allows.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是相信某人的动作，再是那种稳固的感觉，最后是这种感觉所允许的法律安排。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: keys placed in an open palm.
core.cn: 核心意象：钥匙放进摊开的手掌。

branches.en: The person branch: believing someone will not fail.
branches.cn: 人分支：相信某人不会失信。

branches.en: The feeling branch: confidence that stays.
branches.cn: 感受分支：持续存在的信心。

branches.en: The property branch: valuables handed to another.
branches.cn: 财产分支：贵重物交到他人手里。

branches.en: The bond branch: action and feeling feed each other.
branches.cn: 纽带分支：行动与感受互相滋养。

branches.en: The paper branch: a feeling written into law.
branches.cn: 文书分支：把感情写成法律。

intro.en: Trust is a Norse free stem that English combines with worthy, -ful and the prefix dis-.
intro.cn: trust 是诺斯语来源的自由词干，英语把它与 worthy、-ful 以及前缀 dis- 组合。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Norse rather than Latin; the Latin words below express the same idea from another family.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干来自诺斯语而非拉丁语；下面的拉丁词出自另一词族但表达同一概念。

items.example: The stem works as verb and noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干可作动词与名词。

items.example: It forms trustworthy, worth trusting.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trustworthy，值得信任的。

items.example: It forms trustful, full of trust.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trustful，充满信任的。

items.example: It forms trusting, ready to trust.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trusting，愿意信任的。

items.example: It forms distrust, the lack of trust.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 distrust，缺乏信任。

items.example: En makes the noun into an action of handing over.
items.exampleCN: en 把名词变成交付的动作。

items.example: The ending makes a description of the past.
items.exampleCN: 词尾构成对过去状态的描述。

items.meaning: one who holds property for another
items.example: The -ee marks the receiver of the duty.
items.exampleCN: -ee 标记承担职责的一方。

definition_zh: 真相；实情；真理；真实性
definition_en: the real facts about a situation, or a principle that is generally accepted as correct
core_image: 一束光照进昏暗的房间，灰尘和每件东西都被照得清清楚楚
scene: 孩子问起一件旧事，屋里安静下来，大人终于开口。In the end the truth about the broken window came out.
sceneCN: 这里 truth 是「真相；实情」（第 1 个义项：关于某个情况的真实事实）；句意为打破窗子的真相最后终于水落石出。光把昏室里每件东西照亮，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: truth 的词根形容词，义为「真实的」
由 truth 加 -ful 构成，义为「诚实的）
由 un-（否定）与 truth 复合，义为「假话；不实」

senses.title: What really happened
senses.definition: the real facts of a situation, as opposed to what people say or believe
senses.definitionCN: 某种情况的真实事实，与人们的说法或相信的内容相对
senses.example: In the end the truth about the broken window came out.
senses.exampleCN: 打破窗子的真相最后终于水落石出。
senses.why: The noun is built on true with the old ending -th, so truth is literally the state of being true.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词以 true 加古老词尾 -th 构成，truth 字面上就是「真实的状态」。

senses.title: A principle that holds
senses.definition: a belief or rule that is accepted by many as always correct
senses.definitionCN: 被许多人认为始终正确的信念或法则
senses.example: The book is a search for simple truths about human life.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书是对人类生活中几条朴素真理的探寻。
senses.why: A statement true in all cases becomes an idea of truth: a principle that never fails.
senses.whyCN: 在所有情况下都成立的陈述，就成了「真理」这一观念的载体：一条从不失效的法则。

senses.title: The quality of being true
senses.definition: the fact of being accurate or genuine
senses.definitionCN: 准确或真挚的事实
senses.example: There is some truth in what he says.
senses.exampleCN: 他说的有几分道理。
senses.why: Here the word names a measured amount of accuracy, as in there is some truth in it.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词指可度量的准确程度，如「其中有一点真实的成分」那样。

intro.en: Truth was formed in Old English from treowe, faithful, by adding the suffix -th, the same ending as in width.
intro.cn: truth 在古英语中由 treowe（忠信）加后缀 -th 构成，与 width 里的词尾相同。

items.en: A very old root meaning firm and trustworthy lies behind the Germanic word for loyal, and it survives in the family of true and truth.
items.cn: 一个意为牢固、可信赖的极古老词根藏在日耳曼语表示忠实的词后面，并在 true 与 truth 的词族里留存下来。

items.en: The root treuwaz meant firm and loyal, shared by true and truth.
items.cn: 词根 treuwaz 意为牢固、忠实，由 true 与 truth 共享。

items.en: Treowth meant faithfulness, a promise kept between people.
items.cn: treowth 意为忠信，人与人之间守住的承诺。

items.en: Middle English truth moved from faithfulness toward agreement with facts.
items.cn: 中古英语 truth 从忠信转向与事实相符。

items.en: The sense of a general principle settled in the early modern period.
items.cn: 「普遍原理」的意义在近代早期固定下来。

items.en: In truth and to tell the truth keep the everyday spoken force of the word.
items.cn: in truth 与 to tell the truth 保留了这个词的日常口语力量。

note.en: The first group shares the tru stem, the second holds other words for facts and accuracy.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tru 词干，第二组收其他表示事实与准确的词。

entries.definition: Agreeing with the facts.
Telling the truth.
Really and sincerely.
Something known to have happened.
The way things really are.
Correctness in detail.

normalIntro.en: Truth is true with a -th ending, much like warm becomes warmth.
normalIntro.cn: truth 就是 true 加上 -th 词尾，很像 warm 变成 warmth。

normal.en: The -th ending turns an adjective into a noun of state.
normal.cn: -th 词尾把形容词变成状态名词。

normal.en: The plural changes nothing but adds s: truths.
normal.cn: 复数不变形，只加 s：truths。

normal.en: Tell the truth is the simplest phrase built on it.
normal.cn: tell the truth 是它最简单的搭配。

normal.en: The vowel is long, as in food.
normal.cn: 元音是长音，像 food。

normal.en: In truth sits at the start of a sentence like a signal.
normal.cn: in truth 像信号一样放在句首。

abstract.en: Light falling into a dusty room and showing everything.
abstract.cn: 光照进积尘的房间，把一切都显出来。

abstract.en: A door finally opened on the room that was there all along.
abstract.cn: 一扇门终于打开，露出一直都在的房间。

abstract.en: A heavy object set down after being carried a long way.
abstract.cn: 一个被扛了很远的重物终于放下。

examples.en: He told the truth even though it cost him his job.
examples.cn: 他说出了真相，尽管因此丢了工作。

examples.en: There is a little truth in every old story.
examples.cn: 每个古老故事里都有一点真实。

examples.en: Scientists look for truths that hold in every case.
examples.cn: 科学家寻找在任何情况下都成立的真理。

dict_mnemonic.text: true＋th——像宽是 width、暖是 warmth，真是 truth：真实的状态就是真相。

root: 古英语 treowth，由 treowe（忠信）加 -th 构成，与日耳曼语词根 treuwaz（牢固、忠实）同源；同族词有 true、truthful、untruth。

sensesIntro.en: First the facts of a case, then a principle that always holds, then the amount of accuracy a claim contains.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是案情的实情，再是始终成立的原理，最后是一句话所含的准确程度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: light entering a dusty room.
core.cn: 核心意象：照进积尘房间的光。

branches.en: The fact branch: what really happened.
branches.cn: 事实分支：真正发生的事。

branches.en: The principle branch: a rule that never fails.
branches.cn: 原理分支：从不失效的法则。

branches.en: The degree branch: some truth in a claim.
branches.cn: 程度分支：一句话里有几分真。

branches.en: The honesty branch: both rest on a word kept.
branches.cn: 诚实分支：两者都建立在守住的话上。

branches.en: The evidence branch: measuring how much holds.
branches.cn: 证据分支：衡量有多少站得住。

intro.en: Truth is the stem tru plus the old noun ending -th, which English still uses in a few words.
intro.cn: truth 是词干 tru 加古老名词词尾 -th，英语至今只在少数词里用它。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic; the Latin words below express truth and faith from another family.
latinIntro.cn: 词干来自日耳曼语；下面的拉丁词出自另一词族，表达真实与信义。

items.example: The stem is the adjective with the e dropped.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干是去掉 e 的形容词。

items.example: It forms truth, the state of being true.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 truth，真实的状态。

items.example: It forms truthful, full of truth.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 truthful，充满真实。

items.example: It forms untruth, a false statement.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 untruth，不实之词。

items.example: The adjective keeps its final e.
items.exampleCN: 形容词保留末尾 e。

items.example: It forms truthfully, the adverb.
items.exampleCN: 它构成副词 truthfully。

items.example: Truths of every age were compared.
items.exampleCN: 各个时代的真理被放在一起比较。

items.example: The adjective describes a speaker.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述说话的人。

definition_zh: 管；管子；软管；（英）地铁；显像管
definition_en: a long hollow cylinder, usually for carrying liquid or air, or the underground railway in London
core_image: 一根细长的玻璃管横在桌上，里面有一小段液体在慢慢移动
scene: 实验室的桌上放着一根弯成弧形的玻璃管，液体在里面缓缓推进。The water runs through a narrow tube to the garden.
sceneCN: 这里 tube 是「管；管子」（第 1 个义项：用来输送液体或气体的中空长圆筒）；句意为水经过一根细管流向花园。桌上那根弧形玻璃管，就是这个词的画面。

collocations.phrase: the inner tube of a tyre

derivatives.zh: 由 tube 加 -ular 构成，义为「管状的」
与 tube 同源的词，义为「块茎」
由 tube 加 -ing 构成，义为「管材；管道系统」

senses.title: The hollow cylinder
senses.definition: a long narrow hollow object, usually round, used to carry or hold liquid, air, or paste
senses.definitionCN: 细长中空的圆形物，用来输送或盛放液体、气体、膏体
senses.example: The water runs through a narrow tube to the garden.
senses.exampleCN: 水经过一根细管流向花园。
senses.why: Latin tuba meant a straight horn, a hollow pipe used for sound, and the shape carried over to every pipe.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 tuba 指直筒号，一种用于发声的空管，这个形状随后延伸到各种管子。

senses.title: The London railway
senses.definition: the underground railway system, especially in London, whose tunnels are long round tubes
senses.definitionCN: 特指伦敦的地下铁路系统，其隧道就是长长的圆筒
senses.example: She takes the tube to work every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早上乘地铁上班。
senses.why: The first deep lines in London ran in circular tunnels, so passengers simply called the railway the tube.
senses.whyCN: 伦敦最早的深层线路在圆形隧道中穿行，于是乘客干脆把这套铁路叫作 the tube。

senses.title: The electronic display tube
senses.definition: the glass tube inside old televisions and radios that produced pictures or amplified signals
senses.definitionCN: 旧式电视与收音机中产生图像或放大信号的玻璃管
senses.example: The old radio still hums with warm tubes inside.
senses.exampleCN: 那台旧收音机里温热的电子管还在嗡嗡作响。
senses.why: A device shaped like a pipe and doing work inside it naturally took the name of the shape.
senses.whyCN: 形如管、又在管里干活的装置，自然就取了这种形状的名字。

intro.en: Tube comes from the Latin tuba, a long straight trumpet, and reached English through French.
intro.cn: tube 来自拉丁语 tuba（长直号），经法语进入英语。

items.en: Tuba named a long straight horn, a hollow tube that carried sound.
items.cn: tuba 指长直号，即传递声音的空管。

items.en: French tube kept the shape but broadened the use to any hollow pipe.
items.cn: 法语 tube 保留形状，把用途扩展到各种空管。

items.en: English tube first named glass pipes used in science.
items.cn: 英语 tube 最初指科学用的玻璃管。

items.en: The nineteenth century applied it to the tunnels of the London underground.
items.cn: 十九世纪把它用在伦敦地铁的隧道上。

items.en: Electronics used it for the sealed glass part that lights up.
items.cn: 电子学用它指封在玻璃里会发亮的部件。

note.en: The first group shares the tube stem, the second holds other words for pipes and channels.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tube 词干，第二组收其他表示管道与通道的词。

entries.definition: Shaped like a tube.
Tube material or a set of tubes.
A thick underground stem such as a potato.
A tube for carrying water or gas.
A soft flexible tube.
A solid or hollow round shape with straight sides.

normalIntro.en: Tube is a short round word for a short round shape, and English uses it for any long hollow thing.
normalIntro.cn: tube 是个短圆的词，指的就是短圆的形状，英语用它称呼任何细长的中空之物。

normal.en: A tube of toothpaste puts the paste inside the shape.
normal.cn: a tube of toothpaste 就是把牙膏装在这个形状里。

normal.en: The adjective is tubular, not tube-like in form.
normal.cn: 形容词是 tubular，而不是 tube-like。

normal.en: In London, the tube needs a capital letter.
normal.cn: 在伦敦，the tube 常用大写。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: tubes.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s：tubes。

normal.en: The Latin source tuba also named a trumpet.
normal.cn: 拉丁语来源 tuba 也曾指一支号。

abstract.en: A thin glass line holding a small column of liquid.
abstract.cn: 一根细玻璃线上托着一小段液体。

abstract.en: A long round tunnel with lights inside.
abstract.cn: 一条里面亮着灯的圆形长隧道。

abstract.en: A paste being squeezed to the very last turn.
abstract.cn: 一管膏体被挤到最后一卷。

examples.en: Squeeze the tube gently until the glue reaches the paper.
examples.cn: 轻轻挤这管胶，直到胶流到纸上。

examples.en: We took the tube from the station to the market.
examples.cn: 我们从车站坐地铁到了市场。

examples.en: The nurse connected the tube to the bottle.
examples.cn: 护士把管子接到瓶子上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「兔卜」——兔子钻进地里的圆筒洞，正是 tube 那根管子。

root: 拉丁语 tuba（长直号）经法语 tube 进入英语，本义为空心管；同族词有 tubular、tubing、tuber。

sensesIntro.en: First the physical pipe, then the tunnels of the London railway, then the glass parts of radios and televisions.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是实物的管子，再到伦敦铁路的圆形隧道，最后是收音机与电视里的玻璃管。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a curved glass tube holding liquid.
core.cn: 核心意象：盛着液体的弯玻璃管。

branches.en: The pipe branch: carrying water, air, or paste.
branches.cn: 管道分支：输送水、气或膏体。

branches.en: The railway branch: a tunnel become a line.
branches.cn: 铁路分支：隧道变成了线路。

branches.en: The electronics branch: glass doing the work.
branches.cn: 电子分支：玻璃在里面干活。

branches.en: The shape branch: all of them are hollow and round.
branches.cn: 形状分支：全都是中空而圆的。

branches.en: The inside branch: the name belongs to the space within.
branches.cn: 内部分支：这个名字属于里面的空间。

intro.en: Tube is a short Latin stem that English builds on with -ular, -ing and -er.
intro.cn: tube 是短小的拉丁词干，英语在上面加了 -ular、-ing 与 -er。

latinIntro.en: Latin tuba, a straight horn, is the direct source, and the words below share the tube shape.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tuba（直号）是直接来源，下面的词共享「管」的形状。

items.example: The stem names the hollow shape.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干命名中空的形状。

items.example: It completes the modern spelling of tube.
items.exampleCN: 它补成 tube 的现代拼写。

items.example: It forms tubular, like a tube.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tubular，像管子的。

items.example: It forms tubing, tubes as a group.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tubing，成套的管子。

items.example: The set has two glass tubes.
items.exampleCN: 这套装置有两根玻璃管。

items.example: The old horn shares the shape of the word.
items.exampleCN: 那支古号与这个词共享形状。

items.example: The root swells into a round body.
items.exampleCN: 词根膨大成圆块。

items.example: The suffix removes the tube.
items.exampleCN: 词尾把管子去掉。

definition_zh: 曲调；旋律；调音；调校
definition_en: a series of musical notes that is pleasant to hear, or to adjust an instrument or an engine so that it works well
core_image: 一双手拧紧琴弦上的木栓，弦音渐渐对上
scene: 屋里有人弹着旧木琴，低声哼一段熟悉的旋律。She hummed a tune she had learned from her mother.
sceneCN: 这里 tune 是「曲调；旋律」（第 1 个义项：一串悦耳、可哼唱的乐音）；句意为她哼着一支从母亲那里学来的曲子。拧紧琴栓让音对上的那双手，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 tune 加 -er 构成，义为「调音器；调谐器」
由 tune 加 -ful 构成，义为「悦耳的」
由 tune 加 -less 构成，义为「不成调的；走调的」

senses.title: The hummed melody
senses.definition: a short series of musical notes that people can sing or remember easily
senses.definitionCN: 一段易于哼唱和记住的乐音
senses.example: She hummed a tune she had learned from her mother.
senses.exampleCN: 她哼着一支从母亲那里学来的曲子。
senses.why: In the Middle Ages a tune was simply a sound or a tone, and a string of tones became a melody.
senses.whyCN: 在中世纪，tune 只是声音或音调，一串音调便成了旋律。

senses.title: Making the note right
senses.definition: to adjust the strings or keys of an instrument so the notes are correct
senses.definitionCN: 调整乐器的弦或键，使音高正确
senses.example: He tuned the guitar before the concert began.
senses.exampleCN: 演出开始前他给吉他调了音。
senses.why: Since a tune is a tone, to tune is to bring an instrument into the right tone.
senses.whyCN: 既然 tune 是音调，那么 to tune 就是把乐器调进正确的音调。

senses.title: Fitting a machine to its best
senses.definition: to adjust an engine or a device so that it runs smoothly and efficiently
senses.definitionCN: 调整发动机或装置，使其运转顺畅高效
senses.example: The mechanic tuned the engine until it ran quietly.
senses.exampleCN: 机械师把发动机调校到运转安静为止。
senses.why: An engine also has to be brought into harmony, and the ear language travelled to machines.
senses.whyCN: 发动机也需要调到和谐状态，于是耳朵的语言走进了机器。

intro.en: Tune is a variant of tone, both from the Latin tonus, a stretched string and the sound it makes.
intro.cn: tune 是 tone 的变体，二者都来自拉丁语 tonus，指绷紧的弦以及它发出的声音。

items.en: Tonos meant a stretching, and then the pitch of a stretched string.
items.cn: tonos 意为拉紧，后指绷紧的弦的音高。

items.en: Tonus kept both the tension and the sound of a string.
items.cn: tonus 同时保留了弦的张力与声音。

items.en: French had ton for tone and tune for the sound of music.
items.cn: 法语用 ton 表示音调，用 tune 表示音乐的声音。

items.en: English tune named a sound or a mood as well as a melody.
items.cn: 中古英语 tune 既指声音、心情，也指旋律。

items.en: The verb extended from strings to engines and radios: tuned and tuned in.
items.cn: 动词从琴弦扩展到发动机与收音机：tuned 与 tuned in。

note.en: The first group shares the tune stem, the second holds other words for melody and pitch.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tune 词干，第二组收其他表示旋律与音高的词。

entries.definition: A device or person that tunes.
Pleasant to listen to.
Without a clear melody.
A series of notes that make a song.
The quality or pitch of a sound.
To change something slightly to fit better.

normalIntro.en: Tune is tone with a different vowel: a string held at the right tone makes a tune.
normalIntro.cn: tune 就是换了元音的 tone：弦定在正确的音调上，就成了曲子。

normal.en: In tune and out of tune are the two most useful phrases.
normal.cn: in tune 与 out of tune 是最有用的两个搭配。

normal.en: The past form simply adds d: tuned.
normal.cn: 过去式直接加 d：tuned。

normal.en: Tune in means listen to a station.
normal.cn: tune in 意为收听某个电台。

normal.en: The verb works for engines as well as instruments.
normal.cn: 这个动词既用于乐器也可用于发动机。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: tunes.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s：tunes。

abstract.en: A wooden peg turned a little until the string agrees.
abstract.cn: 木栓转一点，直到弦声对上。

abstract.en: Someone humming while walking, unaware of it.
abstract.cn: 一个人边走边哼，自己都没察觉。

abstract.en: Two voices meeting on the same note.
abstract.cn: 两个声音在同一个音上相遇。

examples.en: He whistled a tune from an old film as he worked.
examples.cn: 他一边干活一边吹着一支老电影里的曲子。

examples.en: The piano needs to be tuned before the concert.
examples.cn: 音乐会前钢琴需要调音。

examples.en: The team spent the summer tuning the machine.
examples.cn: 团队花了一个夏天调校这台机器。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吞」——旋律好听，一听就把它整个吞下去，就是 tune 这支曲调。

root: 拉丁语 tonus（紧绷的弦与音调），经古法语 tune 进入英语，与 tone 同源；同族词有 tuner、tuneful、tuneless。

sensesIntro.en: First the melody you can hum, then the act of tuning an instrument, then the act of tuning a machine.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是能哼出来的旋律，再是给乐器调音，最后是给机器调校。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a peg turned until the string answers.
core.cn: 核心意象：木栓转到弦声回应。

branches.en: The melody branch: notes put in a remembered order.
branches.cn: 旋律分支：按记得的顺序排好的音。

branches.en: The instrument branch: bringing strings to the right pitch.
branches.cn: 乐器分支：把弦调到正确的音高。

branches.en: The machine branch: harmony for an engine.
branches.cn: 机器分支：给发动机找和谐。

branches.en: The ear branch: both are judged by listening.
branches.cn: 耳朵分支：两者都靠听来评判。

branches.en: The adjustment branch: small turns make a difference.
branches.cn: 调整分支：小转一下就不同了。

intro.en: Tune is a short free stem that takes -er, -ful, and -less, as well as everyday compounds.
intro.cn: tune 是短小的自由词干，可接 -er、-ful、-less，也常构成日常搭配。

latinIntro.en: The Latin noun tonus sits behind both tune and tone, and the words below share that stretch of sound.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语名词 tonus 是 tune 与 tone 的共同来处，下面的词共享这段声音的张力。

items.example: One stem serves both noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 一个词干兼顾名词与动词。

items.example: It forms tuner, the tuning device.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tuner，调音装置。

items.example: It forms tuneful, full of melody.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tuneful，充满旋律的。

items.example: It forms tuneless, without melody.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tuneless，没有旋律的。

items.example: The band knows fifty tunes.
items.exampleCN: 乐队会五十支曲子。

items.example: The piano was tuned on Monday.
items.exampleCN: 钢琴在周一调好了音。

items.example: They are tuning the radio now.
items.exampleCN: 他们正在调收音机。

items.example: An untuned violin sounds thin.
items.exampleCN: 未调音的小提琴声音发薄。

latinEntries.meaning: a stretch of string, a tone
